fields.description:
Virtusa is a global digital engineering and IT services company that helps Fortune 500 enterprises navigate their digital transformation journeys. With a strong presence in India, especially in Hyderabad, the firm focuses on delivering end‑to‑end solutions across cloud, data, AI, and automation. The company prides itself on a collaborative culture, continuous learning, and a commitment to innovation, which has earned it a reputation as a preferred employer for fresh talent. Over the past decade, Virtusa has expanded its service portfolio and client base, creating a vibrant ecosystem where engineers can work on cutting‑edge technologies and large‑scale projects.

The role of Software Testing Engineer at Virtusa’s PCS HYD campus is designed for fresh graduates or candidates with up to two years of experience who are passionate about quality assurance. As a member of the testing team, you will be responsible for building robust automated test suites, ensuring that applications meet the highest standards of reliability and performance. This position offers exposure to both front‑end and back‑end testing, and provides a platform to work closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver with JavaScript and C#.
2. Collaborate with development teams to understand functional requirements and translate them into comprehensive test cases.
3. Identify, log, and track defects using defect‑tracking tools, ensuring clear communication of issue severity.
4. Execute regression testing cycles for each release and verify fixes.
5. Participate in code reviews, offering feedback on testability and overall code quality.
6. Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing frameworks, processes, and best practices.
7. Prepare test summary reports and metrics for stakeholders.
8. Support Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand‑ups, and retrospectives.
9. Mentor junior testers and share knowledge on automation techniques.
10. Stay updated with emerging testing tools and industry trends.

Tech Stack: Selenium WebDriver, JavaScript, C#, .NET, TestNG/JUnit, Git, JIRA, Agile/Scrum.

Growth Path: Starting as an Associate Test Engineer, you can progress to Senior Test Engineer, Test Lead, and eventually to Quality Assurance Manager or Automation Architect, depending on performance and skill development.

Why Join Virtusa? The company offers a structured learning environment, access to global projects, mentorship from seasoned professionals, and a clear career progression roadmap. fields.title: CWC Recruitment– Assistant Manager, Junior Executive, Technical, Finance & Engineering Posts
fields.skills_required: Analytical thinking, communication skills, basic computer proficiency, knowledge of warehousing operations, financial acumen, engineering fundamentals, problem‑solving, teamwork, adaptability
fields.description:
Central Warehousing Corporation (CWC) is a premier public sector undertaking under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, Government of India. Established in 1957, CWC operates a network of modern warehouses across the country, providing safe storage, handling, and distribution of essential commodities such as food grains, edible oils, and other strategic items. The corporation plays a critical role in ensuring food security, stabilising market prices, and supporting the nation’s supply chain infrastructure. With a workforce of over 10,000 employees, CWC offers a stable, mission‑driven environment where employees contribute directly to national development.

The 2026 recruitment drive opens 327 vacancies across multiple cadres – Assistant Manager, Junior Executive, and a range of Technical, Finance & Engineering positions. These roles are designed for fresh graduates and early‑career professionals who are eager to serve the public sector while gaining exposure to large‑scale logistics, inventory management, and financial operations. As an Assistant Manager, you will lead a team, oversee warehouse operations, and liaise with stakeholders. Junior Executives will support day‑to‑day administrative and operational tasks, while Technical, Finance & Engineering candidates will apply their specialized knowledge to maintain infrastructure, manage budgets, and implement technology solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Supervise and coordinate warehouse activities to ensure efficient storage and dispatch of commodities.
2. Prepare and analyse financial statements, budgets, and cost‑control reports.
3. Conduct regular audits of inventory and ensure compliance with statutory regulations.
4. Implement and monitor safety, quality, and security protocols.
5. Assist in the planning and execution of infrastructure projects, including maintenance of material handling equipment.
6. Liaise with government agencies, suppliers, and customers to resolve operational issues.
7. Prepare periodic performance reports and present insights to senior management.
8. Participate in digitisation initiatives, such as ERP implementation and data analytics.
9. Mentor junior staff and facilitate continuous learning within the team.
10. Contribute to policy formulation and process improvement initiatives.

**Tech Stack & Tools**: ERP (SAP/Oracle), MS Office Suite, basic data‑analysis tools (Excel, Power BI), inventory management software, and familiarity with GIS for warehouse mapping.

**Growth Path**: Starting as an Assistant Manager or Junior Executive, high performers can progress to Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, and eventually to top executive roles such as General Manager. The corporation encourages continuous professional development through government‑approved training programs, certifications, and exposure to national and international best practices.

**Why Join CWC?**
- **Job Security**: As a central government entity, CWC offers unparalleled job stability and attractive pension benefits.
- **Impactful Work**: Employees directly contribute to the nation’s food security and supply chain resilience.
- **Learning Opportunities**: Exposure to large‑scale logistics, finance, and engineering projects provides a solid foundation for a versatile career.
- **Work‑Life Balance**: Structured working hours, generous leave policies, and a supportive work culture promote personal well‑being.
- **Career Advancement**: Clear promotion pathways, regular performance appraisals, and opportunities for higher education support long‑term growth.
fields.eligibility: • Educational Qualification: • Assistant Manager – Any graduate (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com.) or postgraduate. • Junior Executive – Any graduate. • Technical Posts – B.Tech/BE in relevant engineering streams (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer). • Finance Posts – B.Com, BBA, MBA (Finance) or CA/CS. • Minimum aggregate: 55% for general category, 50% for OBC, 45% for SC/ST (relaxations as per government norms). • Age Limit: 18–28 years (relaxations applicable for reserved categories). • Batch: Candidates graduating in 2025 or 2026 are eligible. • Backlog Policy: No active backlogs at the time of application; a maximum of one pending backlog is permissible if cleared before the final selection.

PerfectionGeeks Technologies is a fast‑growing Indian software development firm that specializes in delivering end‑to‑end digital solutions for startups and mid‑size enterprises. Founded by a group of technology enthusiasts, the company has built a reputation for creating scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks. With a collaborative culture, PerfectionGeeks encourages continuous learning, mentorship, and hands‑on exposure to real client projects, making it an attractive destination for fresh engineering talent.

The MERN Stack Developer role is designed for recent graduates or engineers with up to three years of experience who are eager to work on full‑stack web applications. As a member of the development team, you will be responsible for turning product requirements into functional, high‑performance features that run seamlessly on both the client and server sides. You will work closely with senior developers, product managers, and UI/UX designers to deliver clean, maintainable code that meets business goals.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Design, develop, and deploy end‑to‑end features using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.
2. Write reusable, modular front‑end components and back‑end APIs.
3. Implement authentication mechanisms such as JWT and manage secure data flows.
4. Optimize application performance, conduct code profiling, and resolve bugs promptly.
5. Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and adhere to coding standards.
6. Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
7. Maintain version control using Git, manage branches, and ensure smooth CI/CD pipelines.
8. Contribute to documentation, unit testing, and automated testing strategies.
9. Stay updated with the latest trends in the MERN ecosystem and suggest improvements.
10. Assist in deploying applications to cloud platforms and monitoring production health.

**Technical Stack**: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, JavaScript (ES6+), JWT, RESTful APIs, Git, Docker (optional), CI/CD tools.

fields.title: Get Unstoppable on LinkedIn
fields.skills_required: Time Management, Content Creation, Professional Networking, Linkedin Proficiency, Creativity, Next.js
fields.description:
Unstop.com, formerly known as Internshala’s competition platform, is a leading Indian career‑building ecosystem that connects millions of students and fresh graduates with internships, entry‑level jobs, and skill‑based challenges. The platform prides itself on fostering a culture of continuous learning, real‑world problem solving, and community engagement. By leveraging partnerships with global brands and professional networks such as LinkedIn, Unstop creates immersive experiences that help participants sharpen their professional presence, showcase their talents, and earn tangible rewards. The company’s mission is to eliminate the "lurker" mindset and empower every learner to become a proactive contributor in the digital workplace.

The "Get Unstoppable on LinkedIn" competition is a flagship initiative designed to blend gamified problem‑solving with content creation on the world’s largest professional network. Over a span of six weeks, participants will engage in two core challenges: the LinkedIn Zip puzzle series and a series of prompt‑driven LinkedIn posts. The competition not only tests analytical speed and creativity but also encourages participants to build a robust LinkedIn profile, expand their network, and develop a personal brand that stands out to recruiters. Winners receive cash prizes, public recognition on LinkedIn leaderboards, editorial features, and exclusive invitations to the LinkedIn Next Gen Club, along with potential pre‑placement interview (PPI) opportunities with Unstop’s partner companies.

Key responsibilities for participants include:
1. Create and verify a complete LinkedIn profile with at least 30 connections.
2. Play the LinkedIn Zip puzzle at least ten times, solving daily challenges released at 12:30 PM IST.
3. Maintain an average solving time that places them in the top tier of the leaderboard.
4. Craft five high‑impact LinkedIn posts responding to official prompts, using the required hashtags (#MyLinkedInEra, #BeUnstoppable).
5. Submit accurate post URLs on the Unstop portal before the stipulated deadlines.
6. Engage with the competition community by following the official LinkedIn page for leaderboard updates.
7. Adhere to all eligibility criteria, including profile verification and accurate personal information.
8. Demonstrate professionalism and originality in all content to avoid disqualification.

The tech stack for this challenge is primarily the LinkedIn platform itself, supplemented by Unstop’s competition portal. Participants will use LinkedIn’s publishing tools, analytics, and networking features, while Unstop provides a secure registration system, real‑time leaderboards, and automated verification processes. Growth paths emerging from this competition include enhanced visibility to recruiters, potential internships or entry‑level roles with Unstop’s partner ecosystem, and a stronger personal brand that can accelerate career progression.

Why join? Apart from the attractive cash rewards, participants gain hands‑on experience in personal branding, content strategy, and rapid problem solving—skills highly valued by modern employers. The competition also offers a unique chance to be featured in LinkedIn editorial pieces, join an exclusive professional community, and receive mentorship opportunities. For students and early‑career professionals eager to transition from passive observers to active contributors, "Get Unstoppable on LinkedIn" provides a structured, rewarding pathway to showcase talent, expand networks, and kick‑start a successful career.
fields.eligibility: Open to all students (undergraduate, postgraduate) and working professionals across any discipline who have an active LinkedIn account. Participants must create a verified LinkedIn profile, have a minimum of 30 connections, and opt‑in to receive recruiter calls. No academic percentage or backlog restrictions are mentioned, but accurate education and professional details must be provided during registration. Only verified profiles will be considered for prize eligibility.
fields.selection_process: Round 1: LinkedIn Zip Puzzle Challenge → Round 2: Content Creation Challenge (5 LinkedIn posts) → Overall Leaderboard Evaluation (combined scores) → Top performers receive cash prizes, editorial features, and Next Gen Club invitations

fields.description:
Mactores is an agent‑native AWS modernization firm that helps enterprises move legacy workloads to the cloud quickly and cost‑effectively. Founded by a team of seasoned cloud architects, the company built its own automation platform, Aedeon, which eliminates 60‑70% of repetitive consulting work such as discovery, dependency mapping, validation and test generation. By leveraging this platform, Mactores can deliver production‑ready systems, retire legacy environments, and measure outcomes against contractual commitments. Mactores prides itself on a casual, fun office environment that steers clear of rigid corporate norms, encouraging creativity, productivity and personal authenticity.

The HR Recruitment Intern will be a key member of the talent acquisition team for a 90‑day period, with the possibility of a full‑time offer at the end of the internship. The role is designed for students or recent graduates who are passionate about people, enjoy problem‑solving, and want hands‑on exposure to end‑to‑end recruitment for technical positions. Working closely with senior recruiters and hiring managers, the intern will learn to source, screen, and onboard engineering and consulting talent while gaining insight into Mactores’ fast‑paced, technology‑driven environment.

1. Own the recruitment process for two designated positions from requisition to offer.
2. Filter and scan resumes, shortlisting candidates that match role requirements.
3. Log candidate profiles and interview feedback in the ATS.
4. Schedule and coordinate three interview rounds with the hiring panel.
5. Assist with document verification and background‑check procedures.
6. Draft and release offer letters to selected candidates.
7. Ensure smooth joining formalities and induction as per training schedule.
8. Maintain clear communication with candidates, hiring managers and the HR team.
9. Contribute ideas to improve the recruitment workflow and candidate experience.
10. Participate in weekly debriefs to track recruitment metrics and outcomes.

The tech stack for this role primarily involves an Applicant Tracking System, Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and basic familiarity with HR analytics tools. Successful interns can expect a clear growth path: high‑performing interns may transition to full‑time HR Associate roles, later moving into talent acquisition specialist or HR business partner positions. fields.description: About Us: CLOUDSUFI, a Google Cloud Premier Partner, is a global leading provider of data-driven digital transformation across cloud-based enterprises. With a global presence and focus on Software & Platforms, Life sciences and Healthcare, Retail, CPG, financial services and supply chain, CLOUDSUFI is positioned to meet customers where they are in their data monetization journey. Our Values We are a passionate and empathetic team that prioritizes human values. Our purpose is to elevate the quality of lives for our family, customers, partners and the community. Equal Opportunity Statement CLOUDSUFI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and national origin status. We provide equal opportunities in employment, advancement, and all other areas of our workplace. Please explore more at https://www.cloudsufi.com/ About the role Role Summary: Software Engineer, Internal AI Products A Software Engineer who builds the tools this company runs on. You build agent loops, and the loops build the solutions. You work towards a Company Brain that anyone here can ask.35 years’ experience • Reports to the CFO • THE KEY SKILL: You build the agent loops that build the solutions. You will not write every automation by hand. You build the loops that write them. Ship a prototype every week. You ship something every day. You’ll be building a Company Brain with access control. One system that holds what the company knows about finance,delivery and people. Anyone can ask it a question. Each person sees only what they are cleared to see. One hard filter. If you cannot write and debug production code, and have not done it before, please do not apply. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: Work the backlog: You pick items off a live, ranked backlog. You learn each function by building inside it. There is no discovery phase. What you learn goes back into the backlog and changes what comes next. Build the product: You design, build and ship tools that people use every day. Reconciliation, MIS, the deal desk,quote to cash, or whatever the real bottleneck turns out to be. You choose the tools and frameworks. Wire the data: Connect the systems each team already uses, so that the same number means the same thing everywhere. Make it visible: You build live dashboards and alerts that leaders read on their own, instead of asking someone for a report. Keep it running: You own uptime and accuracy for everything you build. Anything that touches money or people needs a person in the loop. THE STACK: Build with: Python and TypeScript. You write production code. Frontier model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, with tool calling and structured output. At least one agent framework. MCP to connect agents to internal systems.Postgres and pgvector, or something similar, for retrieval. You deploy on GCP, and you debug your own work. Work in agents daily: Claude Code, Cursor or something like them, as the way you write code every day. You should have a clear view on how to run the loop, and on when a person has to step in. Connect to: The systems we already run on for accounting, CRM, hiring and IT support, along with Google Workspace.Most of the work is getting them to agree with each other. Check what you ship: Anything that produces a number needs a way to catch it going quietly wrong. Test sets, regression checks, and alerts on the output as well as on the job. WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE: Something you built is running by week two, and someone is using it. • By day 90, time spent on reconciliation or reporting is down by a number you can defend to the CFO. • Every tool you ship has a named owner who is still using it 60 days later. That is the measure that counts. • Leaders stop asking for numbers, because they can already see them. • By the end of your first year, a first version of the Company Brain answers real questions about Finance, and each person who asks sees only what they are cleared to see. WHO THIS IS FOR: You have built products: 3 to 5 years at a software product company, on a product with real users at scale. That means 100k+ monthly active users, or heavy daily use by a large enterprise customer base. You have owned code in production, in front of real users, long after it shipped. • You ship alone: You are comfortable as the only engineer in the room, and the only person on call for what you built. • You work out new ground fast : A domain you do not know is interesting to you. You start without waiting for a spec or an expert. • You are fluent with agents: One person cannot cover a whole company by hand. You use agent loops heavily and youare good at it. • You write and speak clearly: Half this job is pulling a process out of a finance or delivery lead and giving it back to them correctly. You work remotely, so this matters a great deal. HOW WE WILL ASSESS: • A design problem: Live. We give you a function of the B2B company, and you design the system for it. We watch how you break down a domain you do not know, how you size it, and what you leave out on purpose. • A build exercise: Live and screen-shared, on your own setup, with your own agents. You build the way you normally build. We watch how you run the loop, when you step in, and what you decide to skip. • Your work and your questions: We talk about what you have shipped before. You ask us whatever you want. Communication is not a separate round. All three sessions are live, and how clearly you explain your thinking is part of how we judge you. WHERE IT LEADS You report to the CEO and CFO from your first day. Your charter covers the whole company. Nothing sits between you and production. Very few engineering jobs offer all three at once, and that is why this one exists. In 18 months you will know how this company really runs: the data, the money, and the gaps between teams. The rolethen changes shape to fit whatever the biggest open problem is by then. Note : Interested candidates can share their CVs at lishta.jain@cloudsufi.com .

fields.description: Job Description Experience Level: 5+ Years Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote Flexible Executive Overview We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior AI & RAG Platform Engineer with 5+ years of software engineering and applied AI experience to lead the architecture, configuration, optimisation, and production deployment of our generative AI capabilities. In this role, you will be the technical owner responsible for designing advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, managing vector indexing and retrieval lifecycle, orchestrating foundation models (both open-source and proprietary), and embedding these AI services natively into our in-house custom-developed platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Advanced RAG Architecture & Pipeline Configuration • End-to-End Retrieval Pipelines: Design, configure, and optimise enterprise RAG pipelines combining dense vector search, sparse keyword search (BM25), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and cross-encoder reranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE). • Document Parsing & ETL: Build robust ingestion workflows for parsing, segmenting, and embedding multi-format documents (PDFs, Markdown, relational data, APIs) with semantic chunking and hierarchy preservation. • Vector Lifecycle & Operations: Configure and maintain production vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate), including multi-tenant partitioning, payload indexing, and HNSW index tuning. 2. AI Model Selection, Orchestration & Agents • Model Integration: Evaluate, select, and configure foundation models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Llama 3.1/3.3, Mistral) based on cost, context limits, latency, and task complexity. • Agentic Workflows & Tool Calling: Implement structured schema decoding (JSON/Pydantic), function calling, and multi-step agentic execution flows (using LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom workflows). • Fine-Tuning & Serving (Optional/Targeted): Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA) when necessary, and deploy open-weight models via inference servers such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama. 3. Custom Platform Integration & Engineering • API & Microservice Development: Design and expose scalable REST, gRPC, and WebSocket streaming endpoints using Python (FastAPI, asyncio) to interface between LLM workflows and our proprietary platform microservices. • State & Memory Management: Build sliding-window conversational memory, persistent session tracking, semantic caching (Redis / GPTCache), and tenant-level access control at the retrieval boundary. • Async & Event-Driven Processing: Integrate heavy inference and document embedding pipelines into distributed message brokers and queues (Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS). 4. LLMOps, Guardrails & Quality Assurance • Quantitative Evaluation: Establish continuous RAG evaluation frameworks (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) tracking Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Precision, and Hallucination rates. • Guardrails & Security: Implement strict guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard), prompt-injection mitigation, PII masking, and data privacy governance. • Observability: Track latency, token utilization, rate limits, and end-to-end trace flows using Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry. Candidate Requirements & Qualifications Must-Have Requirements • 5+ years of professional backend/software engineering experience, with primary expertise in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, multiprocessing). • 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating RAG pipelines and production LLM-based solutions. • Deep practical knowledge of AI orchestration frameworks: LlamaIndex, LangChain, LangGraph, or custom agent engines. • Production experience with vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus). • Strong background in microservices architecture, RESTful/gRPC design, WebSocket streaming for token generation, and distributed caching (Redis). • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and query performance tuning. • Proficient in Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and major cloud ecosystems (AWS, GCP, or Azure). • Familiarity with RAG evaluation metrics and debugging hallucination/grounding issues. Preferred / Nice-to-Have • Experience deploying high-concurrency LLM inference backends using vLLM or TensorRT-LLM. • Experience with Row-Level Security (RLS) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) applied to vector knowledge bases. • Background in embedding model domain adaptation or LoRA fine-tuning. • Prior experience working within custom SaaS or internal enterprise platforms. Target Technical Stack Domain Technologies Languages & Frameworks Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, Node.js (secondary) RAG & Orchestration LlamaIndex, LangChain, LangGraph, DSPy, Unstructured.io Vector DBs & Search pgvector (PostgreSQL), Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, BM25 / OpenSearch LLMs & Embeddings OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama 3.1/3.3, Mistral, BGE / Voyage Embeddings LLMOps & Evaluation Ragas, TruLens, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, NeMo Guardrails Infrastructure Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, RabbitMQ/Kafka, AWS/GCP, Terraform

fields.description:
Johnson Controls is a global leader in building technologies, automation, and energy efficiency solutions. With a strong focus on digital transformation, the company’s technology teams develop innovative platforms that connect business applications, services, and enterprise systems. The Junior Developer – Enterprise Integration role is based in Pune and is part of the company’s cloud‑centric integration practice, which powers critical business processes across multiple industries.

**Role Summary**
The Junior Integration Developer will design, build, and maintain integration workflows that connect disparate applications using Microsoft Azure services. The position is hands‑on, requiring coding in C#/.NET or JavaScript, and involves creating REST APIs, configuring Azure API Management, and orchestrating data flows with Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and Event Grid. The developer will also contribute to CI/CD pipelines, documentation, and monitoring, while leveraging AI‑assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Design and implement integration workflows using Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions.
2. Build and expose RESTful APIs through Azure API Management.
3. Configure messaging patterns with Azure Service Bus and event handling with Azure Event Grid.
4. Write clean, production‑ready code in C#/.NET or JavaScript.
5. Develop JSON and XML transformations and validate data integrity.
6. Create and maintain Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines for CI/CD.
7. Perform unit and integration testing, debug issues, and resolve defects.
8. Document interface mappings, configuration details, and deployment procedures.
9. Implement logging, tracing, and error handling using Cribl or similar tools.
10. Use GitHub Copilot or Microsoft 365 Copilot responsibly to accelerate development.

**Tech Stack**
Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, API Management), C#/.NET, JavaScript, REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, optional MuleSoft.

**Growth Path**
Starting as a Junior Integration Developer, you will quickly gain expertise in cloud integration patterns and Azure services. With experience, you can progress to Senior Integration Engineer, Solution Architect, or Cloud Integration Lead roles, and eventually move into product management or technical leadership within Johnson Controls’ digital transformation initiatives.

**Why Join**
Johnson Controls offers a dynamic environment where you can work on real‑world integration challenges that impact millions of users worldwide. The company invests heavily in employee growth, providing access to Azure certifications, mentorship, and cross‑functional projects. You’ll be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, while enjoying competitive compensation and benefits.

---

fields.description:
Intel is a global technology leader that designs and manufactures semiconductor chips, cloud‑computing solutions, and AI‑driven platforms. With a strong focus on innovation, Intel invests heavily in research labs across the world, including India, to push the boundaries of compute performance, security, and sustainability. The company’s culture blends cutting‑edge engineering with a collaborative environment, offering employees opportunities to work on products that power everything from data‑centers to personal devices.

The AI System Performance Engineer role in Bengaluru is tailored for recent graduates or early‑career engineers who are passionate about the intersection of artificial intelligence and hardware architecture. The incumbent will be responsible for building analytical models that predict how AI training and inference workloads behave on current and future GPU designs, evaluating multi‑GPU communication patterns, and identifying bottlenecks that affect throughput and latency. This position provides exposure to Intel’s internal simulation frameworks, open‑source performance tools, and real‑world AI workloads such as large language models.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and maintain analytical models for AI training and inference performance across various GPU configurations.
2. Simulate and evaluate memory hierarchy, interconnect bandwidth, and compute utilization for large‑scale AI workloads.
3. Conduct comparative studies of single‑GPU versus multi‑GPU deployments, focusing on communication overhead and scaling efficiency.
4. Adapt open‑source simulators to accurately reflect Intel‑specific architectural features.
5. Generate performance reports and recommendation documents for hardware and system architects.
6. Collaborate with software teams to integrate performance insights into compiler and runtime optimizations.
7. Stay updated on emerging AI workloads, especially LLM training and inference trends, and incorporate findings into models.
8. Participate in cross‑functional design reviews, providing data‑driven feedback on architectural decisions.
9. Automate data collection and analysis pipelines using Python and related libraries.
10. Mentor interns or junior team members on performance modelling techniques.

Tech Stack: Python, NumPy/Pandas, performance simulation tools (e.g., gem5, Accel‑Sim), GPU architecture fundamentals, Linux environment, Git, basic knowledge of CUDA/HIP.

Growth Path: Starting as an Engineer I, the role can progress to Senior Engineer, Principal Engineer, and eventually to Architecture Lead or AI Systems Manager, with opportunities to move into product management or research.

Why Join Intel: Intel offers a world‑class learning ecosystem, mentorship from industry veterans, and the chance to influence next‑generation AI hardware. The hybrid work model ensures flexibility while maintaining strong team cohesion, and the company’s commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a supportive environment for fresh talent.

fields.description: Experience: 814 years Employment Type: Full-time Industry: Fintech, Digital Lending, NBFC, AI/ML and Enterprise Software About the Role We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Lead / Solution Architect to lead the design, development and launch of an AI-enabled digital lending and loan marketplace platform. The platform will combine three core business capabilities: In-house lending: Digital loan origination, underwriting, sanction, disbursement, loan servicing and collections. Lead generation: Digital customer acquisition, lead management, campaign attribution, customer engagement and conversion analytics. NBFC marketplace: Integration with multiple banks and NBFCs, loan-product discovery, eligibility assessment, lender matching and application routing. The candidate will own the end-to-end technical delivery, from architecture and product requirements through development, integrations, testing, deployment and production operations. The role also involves integrating Agentic AI and voice-based AI solutions to automate customer acquisition, loan qualification, verification workflows and customer support. Key Responsibilities 1. Architecture and Product Engineering Design a scalable, secure, API-first architecture for a multi-product digital lending platform. Define the architecture for mobile applications, web portals, backend services, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure. Develop technical roadmaps, solution architecture diagrams, API specifications and data models. Decide appropriate architecture patterns, including modular monoliths and microservices where justified. Lead engineering teams across frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML. 2. Digital Lending and Loan Management Build or integrate a Loan Origination System (LOS) and Loan Management System (LMS). Implement digital onboarding, KYC workflows, credit bureau integrations, income verification and underwriting rules. Develop loan application, credit assessment, approval, sanction letter, e-signing, disbursement and repayment workflows. Integrate bank-account verification, payment gateways, e-NACH/UPI mandates and collection systems where applicable. Build dashboards for loan book performance, overdue accounts, collections, delinquency and portfolio analytics. Ensure the lending architecture supports configurable credit policies and multiple loan products. 3. NBFC Marketplace and Partner Integrations Design a lender integration framework using REST APIs, webhooks and secure data exchange. Build lender onboarding, product configuration, eligibility rules, application routing and offer comparison. Implement application status tracking, partner reconciliation, conversion reporting and commission calculations. Support integration with multiple NBFCs and banks without hard-coding lender-specific business logic into the entire application. Build monitoring and retry mechanisms for failed or delayed partner API transactions. 4. Agentic AI and Voice AI Design and deploy AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer interactions. Build AI workflows for lead qualification, document collection, application assistance, reminders and customer support. Integrate speech-to-text, text-to-speech, LLMs, telephony platforms and CRM systems. Develop AI agents using tool calling, workflow orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and appropriate guardrails. Use AI for document extraction, application data validation, customer-query resolution and operational automation. Implement human escalation, conversation audit trails, consent controls, evaluation frameworks and monitoring. Ensure AI-generated recommendations do not bypass approved credit policies or required human approvals. 5. Lead Generation and Marketing Technology Build lead ingestion APIs, campaign tracking, referral workflows and lead-distribution engines. Integrate Google Ads, Meta Ads, app attribution platforms, CRM systems, call-centre software and marketing automation tools. Develop lead scoring, deduplication, routing, funnel analytics and source-level ROI dashboards. Automate follow-ups through approved communication channels. Track acquisition cost, qualified leads, application completion, sanction rate and disbursal conversion. 6. Technology Stack and Cloud Engineering Backend Strong expertise in Java/Spring Boot or Node.js/NestJS. REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous processing, authentication and integration design. Python/FastAPI experience for AI services is highly desirable. Frontend and Mobile React.js / Next.js for web applications. Flutter, React Native or native Android/iOS development. Responsive customer journeys and internal operations dashboards. Databases and Messaging PostgreSQL or another enterprise relational database. Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ or cloud-managed messaging services. Data modelling, transaction management, caching and reliable event processing. AI/ML LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG and AI workflow orchestration. Voice AI, speech processing and telephony integrations. Python, model evaluation, monitoring and responsible AI practices. Cloud and DevOps AWS or Azure. Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and production observability. Automated testing, logging, incident management, security controls and disaster recovery. The candidate is not expected to be an expert in every technology listed. Strong architectural depth, delivery ownership and the ability to lead specialists are essential. 7. Security and Regulatory Readiness Build security and privacy requirements into the application architecture. Implement role-based access control, encryption, audit trails, secrets management and secure API access. Support consent-based data collection, data-retention controls and borrower-data access restrictions. Work with compliance and lending partners to address applicable RBI digital lending requirements, KYC/AML obligations, borrower disclosures and grievance workflows. Ensure production systems support traceability of credit decisions, loan transactions and customer communications. 8. Project and Team Leadership Translate business requirements into technical specifications, development plans and release milestones. Manage sprint planning, dependencies, technical risks, delivery quality and release readiness. Review architecture, code quality, testing coverage, API design and security. Coordinate product managers, business stakeholders, NBFC partners, vendors and engineering teams. Establish engineering KPIs, production SLAs, incident response procedures and continuous improvement practices. Mandatory Qualifications 8–14 years of overall experience in software engineering, solution architecture or technical project delivery. At least 3 years of relevant experience in fintech, digital lending, loan marketplaces, banking technology or financial-services platforms. Demonstrated experience building and launching a production-grade lending application, financial marketplace or comparable transaction-heavy platform. Strong understanding of LOS/LMS workflows, API integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure and secure application design. Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams and delivering complex products end to end. Practical experience integrating external financial services, identity verification, payment systems or enterprise APIs. Strong stakeholder communication, problem-solving and technical decision-making skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience building an NBFC marketplace or a multi-lender loan aggregation platform. Exposure to personal loans, consumer lending, business loans or unsecured credit products. Hands-on experience building Agentic AI applications, conversational AI or voice-based AI agents. Experience with credit bureau integrations, digital KYC, e-signature and payment mandate workflows. Experience with cloud-native architecture, event-driven systems, high-volume lead generation and customer acquisition platforms. Exposure to credit risk models, fraud detection, document intelligence and lending analytics. Success Metrics The candidate will be measured on: Delivery of the platform against agreed scope and milestones. Reliability and performance of lender and financial-services integrations. Reduction in application processing time and manual operational effort. Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-disbursal conversion. Quality, security, auditability and maintainability of the platform. Successful deployment of production-ready AI and voice automation workflows. Engineering productivity, incident resolution and operating cost efficiency. Interview Evaluation Candidates should be able to demonstrate a system they personally helped architect or deliver. They should explain the architecture, technology choices, integrations, scale, security considerations, challenges and measurable outcomes. Candidates with only project coordination experience, without substantial ownership of architecture or production software delivery, should not be shortlisted.

fields.description:
Deloitte is one of the world’s leading professional services firms, offering audit, consulting, financial advisory, risk management and tax services to a diverse set of clients across industries. In India, Deloitte operates through multiple service lines and has a strong presence in major cities, including Hyderabad, where the firm’s Leadership Center (DU) drives continuous learning and leadership development. The organization is known for its inclusive culture, emphasis on innovation, and a purpose‑driven approach that encourages employees to make a tangible impact for clients and communities.

The role of Associate Senior Assistant – Product Strategy & Management within the Audit and Assurance practice is a hybrid blend of product analysis, customer success, and support operations. As a Customer Success Product Analyst, you will act as a bridge between technical product teams and end‑users, ensuring that complex product issues are resolved efficiently while extracting actionable insights from support data. You will work closely with Customer Success, ServiceNow administrators, and cross‑functional stakeholders to translate feedback into product enhancements and process improvements.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Own end‑to‑end resolution of product support tickets, coordinating with first‑level support and escalating when needed.
2. Investigate and troubleshoot issues that cannot be solved by standard guidance, applying deep product knowledge.
3. Analyse ticket trends, root‑cause patterns and generate short‑term work‑arounds as well as long‑term improvement recommendations.
4. Identify opportunities for product, process and customer‑experience enhancements based on data‑driven insights.
5. Collaborate with Customer Success and product teams to capture and communicate customer pain points and satisfaction drivers.
6. Serve as a liaison between technical and non‑technical audiences, ensuring clear articulation of requirements and solutions.
7. Research, propose and drive process‑improvement initiatives, supporting policy and standard implementation.
8. Maintain and enrich the knowledge repository in ServiceNow, ensuring up‑to‑date documentation.
9. Partner with training teams to upskill first‑level support staff, improving overall resolution efficiency.
10. Provide evidence‑based recommendations to product strategy meetings, influencing prioritisation of features and fixes.

The tech stack for this role primarily includes ServiceNow for ticketing and knowledge management, Microsoft Office suite for reporting and presentations, and familiarity with ITIL frameworks for service management. Deloitte offers a clear growth path – starting as an Associate Senior Assistant, you can progress to Product Analyst, Product Manager, and eventually senior leadership roles within the Audit & Assurance line or broader product strategy domains. Joining Deloitte means exposure to high‑impact projects, mentorship from industry experts, and a culture that rewards curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. The firm’s robust learning platforms, global network, and commitment to work‑life balance make it an attractive destination for ambitious professionals seeking to shape the future of enterprise products.

fields.description:
PepsiCo, a global food‑and‑beverage leader, has a presence in more than 200 countries and a portfolio that includes iconic brands such as Pepsi, Lay's, Gatorade, Quaker and Tropicana. The company is known for its strong focus on sustainability, innovation and inclusive culture, consistently ranking among LinkedIn’s Top Companies and Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies. With a workforce of over 300,000, PepsiCo offers a dynamic environment where fresh ideas are encouraged and employees can make a tangible impact on millions of consumers worldwide.

The Hyderabad office is a strategic hub for PepsiCo’s technology and supply‑chain initiatives across the APAC, India, MENA‑PAK and South Africa markets. The team drives the Integrated Supply Chain Planning (ISCP) solution, leveraging data, analytics and emerging technologies to optimize inventory, demand forecasting and production scheduling. As the company expands its digital footprint, it seeks energetic recent graduates who are eager to learn, collaborate across geographies and contribute to real‑world business outcomes.

**Role Summary**
The Tech Bus Engagement Assistant Analyst will support senior analysts and project leads in day‑to‑day operations of the ISCP platform. The role is ideal for a recent graduate with a strong analytical mindset, good communication skills and a willingness to dive into supply‑chain concepts. You will be involved in data collection, basic analysis, documentation, dashboard creation and stakeholder coordination, gaining exposure to AI/ML‑driven automation projects within a fast‑paced, multi‑regional setting.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Assist in gathering, cleaning and analysing supply‑chain data from multiple markets.
2. Prepare PowerPoint presentations, status reports and simple dashboards for internal and market‑facing audiences.
3. Document process flows, project artefacts and meeting minutes with high accuracy.
4. Track action items, timelines and deliverables across cross‑functional and partner teams.
5. Identify process gaps and suggest improvement opportunities under guidance.
6. Support exploratory work on AI/ML, agents and automation tools relevant to supply‑chain planning.
7. Maintain organized project trackers, version‑controlled documentation and knowledge repositories.
8. Participate actively in team meetings, note‑taking and follow‑up on assigned tasks.
9. Learn and become the technical point of contact for the ISCP solution within the team.
10. Perform ad‑hoc tasks that aid the overall project objectives and team efficiency.

**Tech Stack & Tools**
The role primarily uses Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), basic data‑visualisation tools, and introductory exposure to SQL, Python or R for data manipulation. Familiarity with project‑management platforms (Jira, Confluence) and an interest in AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) is advantageous.

**Growth Path**
Starting as an Assistant Analyst, high performers can progress to Supply‑Chain Analyst, Senior Analyst and eventually to Manager‑level roles overseeing regional ISCP deployments. The position also opens doors to specialized tracks in data‑science, automation engineering or business consulting within PepsiCo’s global supply‑chain ecosystem.

**Why Join PepsiCo?**
PepsiCo offers a vibrant, inclusive culture that values curiosity, collaboration and continuous learning. Employees enjoy global exposure, mentorship from seasoned professionals and opportunities to work on cutting‑edge technology projects that directly influence the company’s operational excellence. Competitive compensation, robust learning programs and a clear career ladder make PepsiCo an attractive launchpad for fresh talent.

fields.description:
Mouser Electronics is a global distributor of electronic components, serving engineers and designers across more than 200 countries. With a strong focus on rapid product availability, technical support, and a robust digital platform, Mouser has positioned itself as a preferred partner for innovators in the hardware and IoT space. The company invests heavily in cutting‑edge technologies, data‑driven supply chain solutions, and a culture that encourages continuous learning and collaboration. As part of its expansion in India, Mouser’s Bengaluru office acts as a hub for software development, product integration, and customer‑facing digital experiences.

The Web Developer role is designed for fresh graduates who are eager to translate business requirements into functional, high‑performance web applications. Reporting to the Lead Engineer, the incumbent will work closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and QA teams to build, test, and maintain web solutions that power Mouser’s e‑commerce portal, internal dashboards, and partner APIs. This position offers exposure to the full software development lifecycle, from requirement gathering to deployment on Azure cloud services.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Analyse user stories and translate them into technical specifications with effort estimates.
2. Design, develop, and maintain web applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC/Core, and related front‑end technologies.
3. Write clean, reusable code and implement unit tests to ensure high code quality.
4. Integrate SQL Server databases (2012/2016) with application layers, optimizing queries for performance.
5. Collaborate with UI/UX teams to implement responsive designs using Bootstrap, CSS, and jQuery.
6. Consume and create RESTful services using JSON and AJAX for dynamic data exchange.
7. Participate in code reviews, version control (TFS/Git), and continuous integration pipelines.
8. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and propose fixes.
9. Stay updated with emerging web technologies and suggest improvements to the existing stack.
10. Contribute to documentation, knowledge‑base articles, and internal best‑practice guides.

**Tech Stack**: C#, ASP.NET MVC/Core, .NET Framework, Visual Studio 2015+, TFS, SQL Server 2012/2016, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, CSS, JSON, AJAX, Azure DevOps.

**Growth Path**: Successful performers can progress to Senior Web Developer, Technical Lead, or specialize in Cloud Architecture and Digital Experience Platforms within 2‑3 years. Mouser encourages certifications in Microsoft technologies and offers mentorship programs.

**Why Join**: Working at Mouser gives fresh talent the chance to impact a global e‑commerce platform used by millions of engineers daily. The company’s emphasis on innovation, a supportive learning environment, and competitive compensation (7.5 LPA) make it an attractive launchpad for a software engineering career.

fields.description:
Google, the world’s leading technology company, has built a reputation for innovation, scale, and impact across a multitude of products and services. One of its most widely used offerings is Google Docs, a cloud‑based document creation and collaboration platform that powers millions of individuals, startups, and enterprises every day. Operating from its vibrant campuses in India, especially the Bengaluru office, Google fosters a culture of openness, continuous learning, and relentless problem‑solving. The company’s mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible resonates strongly within the Docs team, where engineers, product managers, analysts, and designers work together to enhance user experience, improve performance, and drive new feature adoption.

The Analyst role at Google Docs is a pivotal position that bridges data insights with product strategy. As an Analyst, you will dive deep into user behavior, product metrics, and market trends to uncover actionable insights that shape roadmap decisions. You will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and UX researchers to translate raw data into clear recommendations that improve user engagement, retention, and overall product health. This role offers exposure to large‑scale data pipelines, cutting‑edge analytical tools, and a fast‑paced environment where your work directly influences products used by billions worldwide.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Collect, clean, and validate large datasets from internal data warehouses and external sources.
2. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify usage patterns, drop‑off points, and growth opportunities.
3. Build and maintain dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Data Studio.
4. Develop predictive models and statistical analyses to forecast user adoption and feature impact.
5. Partner with product managers to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and track progress against OKRs.
6. Conduct A/B testing design, execution, and result interpretation to guide product experiments.
7. Prepare concise, data‑driven presentations for senior leadership and cross‑functional teams.
8. Automate recurring reporting processes using SQL, Python, or R to improve efficiency.
9. Monitor data quality and implement governance best practices.
10. Stay updated with industry trends and suggest innovative analytical approaches.

Tech Stack: SQL, Python (pandas, numpy), R, Looker/Tableau/Data Studio, Google BigQuery, Git, JIRA, and basic knowledge of cloud services (GCP). 

Growth Path: Starting as an Analyst, you can progress to Senior Analyst, Data Scientist, Product Analyst Lead, and eventually to Product Management or Analytics Leadership roles, depending on your interests and performance. Google encourages continuous upskilling through internal courses, mentorship programs, and conference sponsorships.

Why Join Google Docs? You will be part of a globally recognized brand that values creativity, diversity, and impact. The role offers exposure to massive, real‑world datasets, a collaborative environment, and the chance to influence products that touch millions of users daily. Moreover, Google’s commitment to employee well‑being, flexible work arrangements, and generous benefits make it an ideal place to launch and accelerate a data‑driven career.

fields.title: Annotation Analyst
fields.skills_required: Data annotation, Image labeling, Attention to detail, Photoshop, AutoCAD, VFX, Graphic design, Visual‑spatial reasoning, Basic computer skills, Communication
fields.description:
TELUS Digital is a global technology services firm that helps enterprises design, build and run digital experiences, data platforms and AI solutions. In India, the company operates several delivery centres that focus on data engineering, machine learning, and customer‑centric digital products. With a strong emphasis on innovation, TELUS Digital invests heavily in up‑skilling its workforce and offers a collaborative environment where fresh talent can work alongside seasoned data scientists and engineers.

The Annotation Analyst role is a front‑line position in the AI operations pipeline. As an analyst, you will be responsible for creating high‑quality labelled datasets that power machine‑learning models across various domains such as computer vision, natural language processing, and audio analysis. The position is office‑based in the GIFT City campus of Gandhinagar and follows a 24/7 shift model, meaning you will experience both day and night rotations as part of a dynamic team.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Annotate images, text, audio and video data using proprietary labeling tools while strictly adhering to project guidelines.
2. Review and correct existing annotations to ensure consistency and accuracy across the dataset.
3. Validate labelled data against quality metrics and flag any discrepancies for remediation.
4. Collaborate with machine‑learning engineers and data scientists to clarify annotation requirements and provide feedback on guideline improvements.
5. Work on floor‑plan and interior‑layout datasets, applying visual‑spatial reasoning and using tools like AutoCAD or Photoshop where needed.
6. Maintain productivity targets and meet project deadlines without compromising on quality.
7. Document annotation processes, edge cases, and any challenges encountered during the workflow.
8. Participate in regular quality‑control meetings and contribute to continuous‑improvement initiatives.
9. Adapt quickly to updated annotation protocols and new toolsets introduced by the technical team.
10. Support peer training sessions by sharing best practices and tips for efficient labeling.

Tech Stack: Specialized annotation platforms, Photoshop, AutoCAD, VFX tools, basic scripting for bulk operations, and standard office productivity suites.

Growth Path: Starting as an Annotation Analyst, high performers can progress to Senior Analyst, Team Lead, Quality Assurance Lead, or transition into broader AI Operations roles such as Data Quality Manager or Machine‑Learning Engineer with additional up‑skilling.

Why Join TELUS Digital? You will gain hands‑on experience in the fast‑growing AI ecosystem, work on real‑world datasets that impact products used by millions, and enjoy benefits like two‑way cab service, medical and life insurance, and a clear career ladder. The role offers a stable entry‑level salary, exposure to cutting‑edge tools, and the chance to be part of a supportive, innovation‑driven culture.
fields.eligibility: Any graduate or postgraduate who will graduate in 2026 is eligible. No specific engineering or non‑engineering branch is mandated, but candidates must possess at least one of the following certifications: AutoCAD, VFX, Graphic Design, or Photoshop. Freshers are welcomed; prior professional experience is not required. Candidates should have a minimum of 60% aggregate (if mentioned by the recruiter) and must not have any active backlogs at the time of application. Good computer literacy and attention to detail are essential.
fields.selection_process: Round 1: Written aptitude test (logical reasoning, quantitative & verbal) → Round 2: Practical annotation test (hands‑on labeling task) → Round 3: HR interview (fitment, shift flexibility, salary discussion)

fields.title: Software Development Engineer (SDE) Intern
fields.skills_required: Data Structures & Algorithms, Algorithms, Java, Python, C++, Object Oriented Programming, SQL
fields.description:
Amazon, founded in 1994, has grown into one of the world’s most valuable and customer‑centric technology companies. With a presence in more than 20 countries and a portfolio that spans e‑commerce, cloud computing (AWS), digital streaming, and AI‑driven services, Amazon offers a dynamic environment where innovation is a daily habit. The company’s core leadership principles—Customer Obsession, Ownership, Invent and Simplify—shape a culture that encourages employees to think big, move fast, and deliver results that delight millions of users worldwide. For fresh talent, Amazon provides a platform to work on real‑world problems, collaborate with seasoned engineers, and gain exposure to cutting‑edge technologies that power global scale systems.

The role of a Software Development Engineer (SDE) Intern is designed to give aspiring engineers a taste of full‑stack product development within Amazon’s massive infrastructure. Interns are assigned to a specific team, paired with a manager and a mentor, and are expected to own a deliverable that impacts customers directly. The internship spans 24‑26 weeks of full‑time work (40 hours/week) and can start any time between January and June 2027. Throughout the program, interns will participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and community events, while also receiving mentorship and professional development sessions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Collaborate with cross‑functional Amazonians to design, develop, and ship features that solve real customer problems.
2. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code in languages such as Java, C++, or Python.
3. Build and optimize distributed storage, indexing, or query systems that are scalable and fault‑tolerant.
4. Develop algorithms for large‑scale data processing and predictive analytics.
5. Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and daily stand‑ups within an agile framework.
6. Conduct performance profiling and implement optimizations to improve latency and throughput.
7. Contribute to documentation, unit tests, and integration tests to ensure high quality releases.
8. Communicate technical challenges and solutions effectively to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
9. Explore and prototype emerging technologies (e.g., AWS services, machine‑learning pipelines) that can enhance product capabilities.
10. Adhere to Amazon’s security and compliance standards while building production‑grade software.

Tech Stack: Java / C++ / Python, AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda), Linux, Git, Docker, RESTful APIs, relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), and big‑data tools (Spark, Hadoop) are commonly used. Interns may also get exposure to front‑end frameworks depending on the team.

Growth Path: Successful interns often receive full‑time offers to join Amazon as SDE I or SDE II, with clear career ladders that lead to senior engineering, principal engineer, and leadership roles. The company invests heavily in continuous learning through internal training, tech talks, and mentorship programs.

Why Join Amazon? Apart from a competitive stipend, interns gain unparalleled experience working on systems that serve millions of users daily. The fast‑paced environment pushes you to think critically, solve ambiguous problems, and develop a product mindset. Moreover, Amazon’s global footprint means you can build a network that spans continents, opening doors to diverse career opportunities in the future.

fields.description:
GoComet is a fast‑growing technology company that is redefining global logistics through AI‑driven automation. Founded with the vision of making freight movement seamless, the firm combines deep domain expertise in supply chain with cutting‑edge machine learning, enabling shippers and carriers to make data‑backed decisions in real time. With a presence across major logistics hubs in India and a client base that spans continents, GoComet offers a vibrant environment where innovation meets real‑world impact. The organization invests heavily in research and development, fostering a culture where engineers are encouraged to experiment, iterate, and ship solutions that directly influence the efficiency of global trade.

The Full‑Stack AI Intern role sits within the Nova – Autonomous Outcome Engineering team, a group dedicated to building intelligent agents that automate complex business processes. Interns will work side‑by‑side with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists to design, develop, and deploy end‑to‑end AI solutions. This is a hands‑on opportunity to contribute to production‑grade applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and modern web frameworks. The role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about both front‑end user experiences and back‑end AI orchestration.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Design and implement full‑stack web applications using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
2. Develop Python services that interact with LLMs and RAG pipelines for document extraction and analytics.
3. Build and expose RESTful APIs to integrate AI agents with enterprise systems.
4. Create multi‑step AI workflows, orchestrating agents to automate logistics processes.
5. Write efficient ClickHouse queries and manage data pipelines for real‑time insights.
6. Implement event‑driven architectures using Kafka to ensure scalable communication.
7. Conduct unit, integration, and performance testing to guarantee reliability.
8. Deploy applications on cloud platforms, set up monitoring, and iterate based on feedback.
9. Collaborate with clients to gather requirements, demo prototypes, and refine solutions.
10. Document code, APIs, and workflow configurations for knowledge sharing.

Tech Stack: React.js, TypeScript, Python, Node.js, REST APIs, LLMs (e.g., GPT‑4), LangGraph, RAG, ClickHouse, Kafka, YAML, Git, CI/CD pipelines.

Growth Path: Successful interns can transition to full‑time Software Engineer or AI Engineer roles, with opportunities to lead product modules, specialize in AI research, or move into product management. The exposure to end‑to‑end AI systems accelerates learning and opens doors to senior technical positions.

Why Join GoComet? The internship offers a rare blend of full‑stack development and cutting‑edge AI engineering, providing tangible impact on global logistics. Interns gain mentorship from industry veterans, access to state‑of‑the‑art tools, and the chance to see their code powering real customers. The fast‑paced, collaborative environment ensures rapid skill growth and a strong foundation for a career in AI‑enabled software development.

7. Participate in root‑cause analysis of test failures and propose corrective actions.
8. Maintain inventory of test components and manage spare parts logistics.
9. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance test efficiency and reliability.
10. Stay updated with emerging test technologies and industry standards relevant to optical networking.

Why Join Nokia? Nokia offers a stable, globally recognized brand with a strong focus on innovation in 5G and beyond. fields.skills_required: Accounting Fundamentals, Erp Navigation, Data Validation, Advanced Excel, SQL, Python (Basic), Written And Verbal Communication
fields.description:
YipitData is a global market‑research and analytics firm that has carved a niche in the disruptive economy space. Backed by a $475 million investment from The Carlyle Group and valued at over $1 billion, the company leverages proprietary technology to sift through billions of alternative data points, turning raw information into actionable insights for sectors such as software, AI, cloud, e‑commerce, ridesharing and payments. With offices across the United States, APAC and India, YipitData serves a client roster that includes top‑tier investment funds and Fortune 500 corporations, helping them make high‑stakes decisions with confidence.

The firm’s culture has repeatedly been recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace, emphasizing transparency, ownership and continuous learning. Employees are encouraged to take charge of high‑impact projects from day one, enjoy rapid career growth, and are rewarded based on merit rather than seniority. This environment makes YipitData an ideal launchpad for ambitious freshers who thrive on fast‑paced, purpose‑driven work.

**Role Summary**
As a Data QA Associate for the SpendHound SaaS platform, you will be the guardian of data quality for financial and accounting information that powers expense‑analysis for finance, operations and procurement teams. Working remotely from India, you will collaborate with engineering and data teams in the U.S. and China, using YipitData’s proprietary software to clean, validate and enrich raw transaction data.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Review and validate accounting data exported from ERP systems, including vendor, invoice, bill, payment and transaction records.
2. Apply accounting knowledge to map bookkeeping patterns to correct expense categories.
3. Correct vendor and spend‑category mappings to ensure consistency.
4. Identify and resolve duplicated, incomplete or inconsistent records.
5. Investigate root causes of data quality issues and propose rule‑based improvements.
6. Work closely with data engineers to refine data‑processing pipelines.
7. Maintain compliance with data‑security and confidentiality policies.
8. Document QA processes and create knowledge‑base articles for the wider team.
9. Manage multiple validation streams in parallel while meeting daily SLAs.
10. Mentor junior QA associates as the team scales.

**Tech Stack & Tools**
The role primarily uses YipitData’s internal data‑quality platform, but familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Ramp or Xero is essential. Basic proficiency in Excel, SQL and Python for ad‑hoc analysis is a plus.

**Growth Path**
High performers can progress to Senior Data QA Lead, then to Data Quality Manager, eventually moving into broader data‑engineering or product‑management tracks. The company’s merit‑based promotion policy ensures that impact translates quickly into responsibility and compensation.

**Why Join YipitData?**
- Work on cutting‑edge data products that influence multi‑billion‑dollar decisions.
- Gain exposure to global teams across the U.S., China and India.
- Enjoy a people‑centric culture that rewards ownership and fast learning.
- Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits and clear, impact‑driven career progression.
- Fully remote setup with flexible hours while still offering meaningful collaboration across time zones.
fields.eligibility: Bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Finance, Business, Statistics, Computer Science or related field; 0‑2 years of relevant internship or entry‑level experience in accounting, bookkeeping or data quality assurance.
fields.selection_process: Round 1: Online assessment (aptitude & Excel basics) → Round 2: Technical interview (accounting concepts, ERP knowledge, data QA scenarios) → Round 3: HR interview (cultural fit, motivation, salary expectations)

fields.title: Application Security Engineer
fields.stipend_salary: 12 LPA - 20 LPA (depending on experience and skill set)
fields.skills_required: Owasp Top Ten, Burp Suite, Nmap, Sqlmap, Kali Linux, Python, Bash
fields.description:
Bugcrowd, founded in 2012, is a global leader in crowdsourced security testing and vulnerability management. Headquartered in San Francisco and New Hampshire, the company combines AI‑driven intelligence with a worldwide community of ethical hackers to help enterprises discover, prioritize, and remediate real‑world security risks. Backed by prominent venture capital firms such as General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, and Costanoa Ventures, Bugcrowd has grown rapidly and now serves some of the world’s largest brands across multiple industries, including automotive, IoT, mobile, and embedded systems. The company’s culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion, making it an attractive workplace for security enthusiasts.

As an Application Security Engineer (ASE) at Bugcrowd, you will be at the heart of the company’s bug bounty and vulnerability assessment operations. You will triage, validate, and prioritize incoming security reports from researchers, ensuring that each finding is accurately classified and communicated to the relevant client teams. The role offers exposure to a wide variety of application types—from web and mobile apps to embedded devices—allowing you to deepen expertise in complex vulnerability classes such as XSS, SQLi, XXE, IDOR, SSTI, and SSRF. You will also collaborate closely with the Director of Technical Operations to design and improve internal tooling, automate repetitive triage tasks, and contribute to incident response for high‑severity bugs.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Perform detailed triage of vulnerability submissions, validating reproducibility, impact, and severity.
2. Communicate with researchers and clients to gather additional information and clarify findings.
3. Escalate critical vulnerabilities to clients and coordinate incident‑response activities.
4. Maintain and enhance internal triage and validation tooling using scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
5. Conduct independent security assessments on diverse platforms, including web, mobile, IoT, and embedded systems.
6. Produce clear, concise remediation guidance and documentation for clients.
7. Stay up‑to‑date with the latest OWASP Top Ten threats and emerging attack techniques.
8. Contribute to knowledge‑sharing sessions, internal blogs, and community outreach initiatives.
9. Assist in onboarding new researchers and clients to Bugcrowd’s platform.
10. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to streamline workflow and reduce false‑positive rates.

Tech Stack & Tools: OWASP Top Ten, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, sqlmap, Kali Linux utilities, Python/Bash scripting, Git, CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), and basic familiarity with containerization (Docker). 

Growth Path: Starting as an ASE, you can progress to Senior Application Security Engineer, then to Technical Lead or Manager of Technical Operations. Bugcrowd also offers pathways into specialized roles such as Threat Intelligence Analyst, Security Researcher, or Product Security Engineer, depending on your interests and performance.

Why Join Bugcrowd? You will work with the world’s most skilled security researchers, gain hands‑on experience across a broad spectrum of technologies, and be part of a fast‑growing startup recognized as one of the “10 Coolest Security Startups of 2016.” The remote‑first model provides flexibility, while the inclusive culture ensures you can bring your whole self to work and grow both technically and professionally.
fields.eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or related engineering discipline; minimum 60% aggregate (or CGPA 6.0/10); no active backlogs at the time of joining; freshers from the 2025‑2027 batch are encouraged to apply; strong passion for security research demonstrated through projects, blogs, or open‑source contributions.
fields.selection_process: Round 1: Online technical assessment (vulnerability analysis and basic scripting) → Round 2: Live security triage interview (case study and problem‑solving) → Round 3: HR interview (culture fit, motivations, and salary discussion)

Guide learners through cloud infrastructure and deployment on AWS (S3, CloudFront, EC2, ECS, RDS) and managed platforms.
