fields.title: Quality Audit Representative, ICMRS Auditing
fields.skills_required: Cctv Analysis, Microsoft Office (Word, Advanced Excel, Outlook), Written And Verbal Communication, Data Privacy Compliance, Audit Documentation, Time Management
fields.description:
Amazon is one of the world’s largest e‑commerce and cloud‑computing companies, known for its relentless focus on customer obsession, operational excellence and innovation. In India, Amazon operates a massive logistics network that includes fulfillment centers, sortation hubs, and a sophisticated Transportation Execution system. The Network Operations Center (NOC) is the nerve‑center of this ecosystem, monitoring the movement of millions of parcels daily and ensuring that any deviation from the planned flow is quickly identified and resolved. Working at Amazon means being part of a culture that encourages ownership, data‑driven decision making, and continuous improvement, while offering employees the chance to impact millions of customers worldwide.

The Quality Audit Representative for ICMRS Auditing plays a critical role within the NOC. The role involves reviewing CCTV footage from Amazon’s fulfillment and sortation sites to verify that standard operating procedures are being followed. Auditors act as the eyes of the organization, spotting process gaps, documenting non‑compliance, and feeding insights back to operations teams for corrective action and automation. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy meticulous analysis, have a keen eye for detail, and can work efficiently in a fast‑paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Review CCTV recordings from designated Amazon sites and answer predefined audit questions for each video segment.
2. Navigate camera‑viewing software to locate the correct footage based on location and timestamp.
3. Complete the daily quota of audits while maintaining high speed and accuracy.
4. Develop familiarity with site layouts, package flow, and camera naming conventions to expedite footage retrieval.
5. Record audit findings in the audit system, capture screenshots as evidence, and store them according to compliance timelines.
6. Follow step‑by‑step checklists for each audit question and flag ambiguous or unusual observations to team leads.
7. Submit audit results on the prescribed schedule – daily, weekly, or bi‑weekly.
8. Uphold strict confidentiality and data‑privacy standards for all video footage and audit data.
9. Participate in onboarding training, shadow experienced auditors, and gradually take ownership of multiple audit types.
10. Meet defined quality standards for audit accuracy and contribute to periodic review sessions aimed at process improvement.

Tech Stack & Tools: CCTV surveillance systems, proprietary Amazon audit platform, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook), basic data‑visualisation tools, and secure file‑storage solutions.

Growth Path: Starting as a Quality Audit Representative, high performers can progress to Senior Auditor, Audit Team Lead, Operations Analyst, or move laterally into broader NOC roles such as Process Improvement Specialist or Automation Engineer.

Why Join Amazon: Employees gain exposure to world‑class logistics operations, receive continuous learning opportunities, and benefit from Amazon’s competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that rewards innovation and ownership.
fields.eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with minimum 60% aggregate (or CGPA 6.0/10). No active backlogs at the time of joining. Fresh graduates from the 2024‑2026 batch are preferred. Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and effective communication skills are mandatory.
fields.selection_process: Round 1: Online assessment (logical reasoning & situational judgment) → Round 2: Functional interview (audit process, scenario based questions) → Round 3: HR interview (culture fit, behavioral questions based on Amazon Leadership Principles)

The commission operates under the aegis of the State Government, ensuring that the recruitment process is fair, unbiased, and aligned with the evolving administrative needs of Andhra Pradesh. With a robust infrastructure that includes multiple regional offices, a sophisticated online application portal, and a dedicated team of subject matter experts, APPSC consistently delivers high‑quality talent to the public sector.

The Group 2 recruitment for 2026 opens up a massive opportunity with 720 vacancies across diverse departments such as Revenue, Health, Education, and Rural Development. These positions are entry‑level administrative roles that serve as the backbone of state governance, handling tasks ranging from data management and public interaction to policy implementation and field supervision. Candidates selected will be part of a structured career ladder that offers clear pathways for promotion to Group 1 and higher echelons of the state bureaucracy.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Managing day‑to‑day administrative operations within assigned departments.
2. Preparing, maintaining, and updating official records and reports.

fields.description:
Zeno is an emerging player in the Indian electric two-wheeler ecosystem, focused on building cutting‑edge EV technology for the mass market. Founded by a team of automotive engineers and entrepreneurs, the company combines deep domain expertise in powertrain design with modern software‑driven product development. With a rapidly expanding R&D centre in Bangalore’s HSR Layout, Zeno aims to accelerate the transition to sustainable mobility by delivering reliable, high‑performance electric scooters and components. The firm prides itself on a collaborative culture where engineers are encouraged to experiment, fail fast, and iterate on real‑world hardware.

The Firmware Engineering Internship offers a unique gateway for fresh engineering talent to dive into the world of automotive‑grade embedded systems. Interns will work side‑by‑side with senior firmware and hardware engineers on live EV projects, gaining exposure to the complete product lifecycle—from concept and prototype to validation and production hand‑over. This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about electric vehicles, love hands‑on hardware work, and are eager to translate classroom theory into tangible automotive solutions.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Assist in developing, testing, and debugging embedded firmware for EV subsystems such as motor controllers, battery management units, and sensor interfaces.
2. Support component‑level and system‑level testing using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and custom test rigs.
3. Participate in hardware‑software integration, ensuring reliable communication over CAN, UART, SPI, and I2C buses.
4. Collect, analyze, and interpret test data to evaluate performance, reliability, and safety margins.
5. Document test procedures, results, and engineering change records in accordance with automotive standards.
6. Troubleshoot hardware and firmware issues, applying systematic debugging techniques.
7. Contribute to design reviews, providing feedback on firmware architecture and hardware compatibility.
8. Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including powertrain, mechanical, and manufacturing engineers.
9. Learn and apply automotive‑grade development tools such as version control, continuous integration, and static analysis.
10. Stay updated with emerging EV technologies and suggest improvements to existing firmware modules.

Tech stack exposure includes C/C++ programming, STM32/ARM microcontrollers, CANopen, AUTOSAR basics, and industry‑standard debugging equipment. Successful interns can look forward to a clear growth path: high‑performing interns may be offered full‑time roles as Firmware Engineers, with opportunities to lead sub‑system projects, mentor future interns, and eventually move into senior system architecture positions. Joining Zeno means becoming part of a mission‑driven team that is shaping the future of electric mobility in India, gaining hands‑on experience that is highly valued across the automotive and IoT sectors.

fields.description:
Google, a global technology leader founded in 1998, has grown into a conglomerate that spans search, cloud, advertising, hardware, and cutting‑edge research. With a mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible, Google invests heavily in scientific discovery, AI breakthroughs, and sustainable solutions. The company’s research arms – Google Research, DeepMind, and Google AI – collaborate with universities and industry partners to push the frontiers of computer science, quantum computing, and human‑computer interaction. As a fresher‑focused portal, Jobdexo highlights Google’s reputation for fostering an inclusive, innovative culture where engineers and scientists are encouraged to experiment, publish, and translate ideas into products used by billions.

The Student Researcher role is a paid internship designed for undergraduate, master’s, or PhD students who wish to contribute to real‑world research projects across Google’s many divisions. Interns are placed on teams that align with their academic interests – ranging from natural language processing and computer vision to algorithmic optimization and quantum information science. The program runs for a flexible duration, typically 12‑24 weeks, and can be completed remotely from any approved Indian location. Interns work under the mentorship of senior researchers, receive access to Google’s internal tools and datasets, and are expected to produce a tangible research artifact such as a paper draft, prototype, or open‑source contribution.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Conduct literature reviews and identify gaps relevant to the assigned project.
2. Design, implement, and evaluate algorithms or models using Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
3. Process large‑scale datasets, ensuring data quality and reproducibility.
4. Collaborate with cross‑functional engineers, product managers, and domain experts.
5. Write clear technical documentation and present findings in internal seminars.
6. Contribute to code repositories following Google’s style guides and review processes.
7. Participate in weekly mentorship meetings and sprint planning sessions.
8. Explore potential patents or conference submissions based on research outcomes.
9. Assist in building demo applications or visualisations for stakeholder review.
10. Stay updated with the latest research trends and share insights with the broader team.

Tech stack typically involves Python, JAX, TensorFlow, PyTorch, C++, SQL, and cloud services like Google Cloud Platform for scalable experiments. Successful interns often continue as full‑time research engineers or pursue advanced degrees with Google’s support.

Growth path: High‑performing interns may receive a return offer for a full‑time Research Engineer or Software Engineer role, gain access to internal research seminars, and be encouraged to publish in top conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR). The exposure to cutting‑edge problems and mentorship from world‑renowned scientists accelerates career development.

fields.description:
Deutsche Bank is one of the world’s leading financial services providers, operating in more than 70 countries with a strong presence in India. The bank’s Indian operations span corporate banking, investment banking, wealth management and technology services, serving a diverse client base ranging from multinational corporations to high‑net‑worth individuals. Deutsche Bank prides itself on a culture of inclusion, continuous learning and responsible banking, encouraging employees to innovate while adhering to the highest standards of risk and compliance. The firm’s commitment to digital transformation has created a fertile ground for fresh talent to contribute to cutting‑edge processes and AI‑driven solutions.

The Operations Analyst role in the Jaipur office is a front‑line position within the bank’s Operations division. The analyst will be the guardian of trade‑related voice logs, ensuring that every conversation between Relationship Managers and clients is captured accurately, reviewed against predefined standards, and documented in the appropriate product‑specific templates. This role is pivotal for maintaining data integrity, supporting audit readiness, and delivering a seamless client experience. The analyst will also act as a backup for peers, share best practices, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Review voice logs between RCs and clients to validate that trade details are discussed and agreed as per standards.
2. Listen attentively to conversations and accurately document agreed details in the prescribed templates.
3. Complete product‑specific voice‑log review templates with precise observations and outcomes.
4. Identify missing, inconsistent, or unclear trade details and escalate exceptions within agreed timelines.
5. Ensure daily production activities meet SLAs, cut‑off times and quality expectations.
6. Perform quality checks on completed reviews to support audit readiness.
7. Prepare and review daily control/production reports, tracking open items and follow‑ups.
8. Coordinate with RCs and business teams for clarification and resolution of deficiencies.
9. Maintain proper documentation and evidence of review outcomes for internal control and management reporting.
10. Act as a backup for peers, facilitate knowledge sharing and support process improvements.

The tech stack for this role primarily includes Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and AI‑enabled productivity tools that help automate parts of the review workflow. Familiarity with banking trade lifecycle concepts, wealth‑management products, and basic data‑analysis techniques will be advantageous.

Career growth at Deutsche Bank is well‑structured: analysts can progress to senior analyst, associate, and eventually to managerial roles within Operations or move laterally into product, risk, or compliance functions. The bank offers sponsorship for industry‑relevant certifications, continuous training, and exposure to global best practices, making it an attractive launchpad for fresh graduates.

Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

Job Overview

The Junior AI Platform Engineer supports the development and operation of platforms used to deploy, integrate, scale, secure, and monitor AI and machine learning solutions. The role combines software engineering, backend development, cloud computing, containerization, DevOps, and AI platform fundamentals.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in developing backend services supporting AI and machine learning workloads.
• Develop and test REST APIs using Python or another approved programming language.
• Integrate machine learning models and Generative AI services with enterprise applications.
• Package applications and services using Docker and support deployment to Kubernetes environments.
• Assist with asynchronous jobs, background processing, scheduled workloads, and service-to-service communication.
• Support cloud configuration, infrastructure automation, release pipelines, and environment management.
• Implement input validation, error handling, logging, telemetry, and API documentation.
• Support identity, access control, secret management, network security, and responsible data handling.
• Write unit, integration, API, and basic load tests.
• Investigate defects and production issues, escalating complex problems with evidence and impact details.
• Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and technical documentation.
• Collaborate with Machine Learning, Product Engineering, Product Support, and business teams.

Essential Job Functions

API and Backend Development

• Build basic REST APIs and backend components.
• Integrate applications with databases, model endpoints, and external services.
• Apply validation, error handling, logging, and API documentation standards.

Cloud and Container Platforms

• Create and maintain Docker configurations.
• Support Kubernetes deployments, services, configuration, secrets, and scaling.
• Learn Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, monitoring, serverless, and AI services.

DevOps and Automation

• Use Git and GitHub-based workflows.
• Support automated build, test, security-check, and deployment pipelines.
• Maintain deployment, environment, and operational documentation.

Reliability and Security

• Monitor service health and investigate failures or performance bottlenecks.
• Follow platform security, access control, vulnerability management, and data-handling standards.
• Support reliability, scalability, availability, and disaster-recovery practices.

Required Qualifications And Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related field.
• 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, or personal projects.
• Programming knowledge in Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or a similar language.
• Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, databases, and SQL.
• Basic familiarity with Linux command-line operations.
• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.

Preferred Skills

• Exposure to Microsoft Azure.
• Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, ASP.NET Core, Node.js, or a similar backend framework.
• Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
• Exposure to Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, or Power Platform.
• Basic understanding of queues, caching, serverless functions, asynchronous processing, OAuth, managed identities, role-based access control, and secrets management.

Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training

Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment.

• Python, object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms
• Linux, shell fundamentals, Git, and GitHub workflows
• HTTP, HTTPS, JSON, REST APIs, webhooks, and WebSockets
• FastAPI or an equivalent backend framework
• SQL, relational databases, and basic NoSQL concepts
• Docker and container fundamentals
• Kubernetes architecture, deployments, services, configuration, security, and scaling
• Azure fundamentals, App Service, Functions, Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service
• Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, and Azure OpenAI integration
• CI/CD with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
• Logging, monitoring, alerts, telemetry, testing, identity, secrets, and application security

Pre-Joining Capstone

Develop an AI-enabled API, package it in Docker, apply automated tests, and deploy it through a basic CI/CD pipeline to an approved cloud or simulated environment.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

Our Benefits:

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. fields.description:
Introduction

About The Team

The Connect UI team builds the experiences Confluent Cloud customers use to bring data into and out of Kafka. That covers browsing and setting up fully managed and custom connectors, troubleshooting connector failures with AI assistance, and visualizing how connectors are performing. Connectors are where customers' real-time data enters the platform, so the quality of what we build directly affects how quickly customers get up and running

About The Role

We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who's excited to help build engaging, intuitive products for managing and visualizing large-scale, real-time data streams. Data flow is central to how companies operate, and we aim to make that experience simple and attractive. Working with mentorship from senior engineers, you will help develop features across the Connect experience in Confluent Cloud and steadily grow into an owner of parts of the product.

• Our Cloud UI is built with React and TypeScript on our own design system, and connects to multiple REST and GraphQL APIs.
• We test with Jest and React Testing Library (unit) and Playwright (end-to-end).
• We deploy to production daily and can test every commit, including PRs, before it goes live. Feature flags let us release independently of backend teams, and bots keep our dependencies up to date.
• AI-assisted development tools are part of our everyday engineering workflow.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Frontend Software Engineer, you will help build client-side features for data-intensive products, working closely with senior engineers, designers and product managers.

You Will

• Help develop new features from user requirements and designs, taking on well-defined tasks within larger features, delivering them on time, refining them based on feedback, and growing the scope you own over time.
• Build UI components and interactions to the design specifications using our design system, and integrate with backend APIs, working with backend engineers to understand API contracts and handle loading, error and empty states well.
• Write clean, readable code with unit and end-to-end tests, and write short design notes for your tasks for peer review.
• Take part in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback.
• Help investigate and fix bugs and production issues, starting by shadowing the on-call rotation.
• Share your progress clearly in standups and project updates, and raise blockers early.
• Learn Confluent's engineering practices, including release, monitoring and feature flag processes, and how our product works end to end.

Preferred Education

As a Consultant-level AI Developer (MCP Engineer) at Deloitte Consulting, you will design and build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in Python that expose enterprise system capabilities as reusable tools for AI agents built on platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Moveworks, and pro-code solutions like Azure AI Foundry.

fields.description:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
 
About the Role- 
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Insights & Growth
- Drive data-led growth across the acquisition, retention, churn, revenue and GMV lifecycle.
- Own deep-dive analytics to identify key drivers and opportunities for acquisition, engagement, retention and churn reduction.
- Drive Revenue and GMV growth in line with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) through actionable insights and growth recommendations.
 
Customer & Lifecycle Analytics
- Analyse cohorts, journeys, segments and behavioural trends to improve customer lifetime value and repeat transactions.
- Build cohort and retention frameworks (D0/D7/D30, monthly triangles) across new, reactivated and repeat users.
- Diagnose churn and cancellation drivers and recommend structural fixes, not surface-level corrections.
 
Campaign Efficacy & Attribution
- Measure and optimize campaign efficacy — identifying the right segments, propositions, channels and levers to maximize incremental GMV and revenue.
- Conduct funnel, cohort, campaign and attribution analysis to identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
- Reconcile promotional burn against incremental GMV; establish ROI and cost-per-incremental-user benchmarks by campaign and segment.
- Analyse A/B tests and control-group experiments to isolate true incrementality.
 
Metrics, Dashboards & Models
- Build and track key business metrics, dashboards, performance frameworks and analytical models to monitor growth against AOP.
- Own metric definitions and data integrity; maintain a single source of truth across teams.
- Develop forecasting and scenario models for GMV, revenue and user base to support planning cycles.
 
Stakeholder Partnership
- Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, DWH and Business teams to convert insights into measurable outcomes.
- Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for senior stakeholders and drive data-backed decision-making.
- Own analytical inputs for MBRs and business reviews — with a clear storyline, not just charts.
 
REQUIREMENTS
Experience
- 8-10 years of experience in business analytics, growth analytics or data science — preferably in consumer internet, fintech, e-commerce or financial services.
- Demonstrated ownership of a product vertical or growth charter with measurable business impact.
- Experience with large-scale transactional and behavioural datasets in a high-velocity consumer business.
 
Technical Skills
- SQL — advanced: complex joins, window functions, CTEs and query optimization on large distributed datasets (Trino/Presto/Hive/Redshift/BigQuery).
- Python — pandas, numpy, statistical testing and automation; modelling libraries a plus.
- Advanced Excel — pivots, complex formulas & macros
- Data Modelling — dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, event and funnel data structures, metric-layer design.
- Data Visualization — Tableau, Power BI, Superset or equivalent; dashboards that get used, not just built.
- Product & Web Analytics — Google Analytics, CleverTap, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Firebase for funnel and journey analysis.
 
Analytical & Business Capabilities
- Strong command of cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention curves, LTV modelling, attribution methodologies and experiment design.
- Comfort with significance testing, regression, segmentation and clustering techniques.
- Commercial instinct — able to connect a metric movement to the underlying business mechanic and the money at stake.
- Excellent communication; able to defend a recommendation with evidence in front of senior leadership.
 
Education
- Bachelor’s in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative discipline. MBA or Master’s in a quantitative field preferred.
 
GOOD TO HAVE
- Exposure to wealth, investments, savings or commodity-linked products.
- Experience with SIP / recurring-payment analytics, including mandate and autopay behaviour.
- Familiarity with pricing, margin and unit-economics analysis.
- Experience mentoring junior analysts.
 
CORE COMPETENCIES
- Diagnostic mindset — pushes past the symptom to the root cause.
- Rigour — validates counts and stress-tests assumptions before publishing.
- Ownership — treats the business target as their own.
- Clarity — reduces complexity to a decision, not a data dump.
- Constructive dissent — challenges assumptions and targets with data, early.
 
Why join us: 
Work with a high-performing and passionate product, design, and engineering team. 
Shape the future of credit for millions of users. 
Build at scale in one of India’s most dynamic and regulated spaces. 
Flexible and inclusive work environment with fast decision-making and ownership. 
 
Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

fields.skills_required: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Redux
fields.description:
Role Overview  
The Area Collections Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end collections across  bucket segments, driving resolution strategies, ensuring portfolio health, and leading large  on-ground and tele-calling teams. The role requires strong expertise in delinquency  management, compliance, analytics, and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities  
1. Bucket & Portfolio Management  
● Manage collections across delinquency buckets (0–30, 31–60, and higher DPD  segments)  
● Improve resolution rates in both early and late buckets  
● Focus on non-starter and delinquent accounts to prevent roll-forward  
● Drive collection efficiency and overall portfolio health  
● Monitor daily performance and ensure adherence to CAPE norms  

2. Tele-Collections Management  
● Handle soft delinquency buckets (0–30 & 31–60 DPD) through tele-calling strategies  
● Design and optimize calling patterns based on customer risk profiling  
● Improve dialer efficiency, call connect rates, and campaign performance  
● Maximize early-stage resolutions to prevent migration to hard buckets  

3. Field Collections & Risk Control  
● Ensure strong field discipline (app usage, visit tracking, audit trails)  
● Drive legal escalation for critical/high-risk cases  
● Conduct audits to identify and mitigate portfolio risks  
● Maintain strong governance and control mechanisms  

4. Team Leadership & Vendor Management  
● Lead large teams including Collection Managers, Team Leaders, and Executives  
● Manage third-party/vendor collection agencies  
● Allocate portfolios and set bucket-wise targets  
● Conduct daily huddles, reviews, and performance tracking  
● Coach teams on negotiation, objection handling, and resolution strategies  

5. Target Achievement & Performance Delivery  
● Drive monthly collection targets and improve resolution ratios  
● Enhance PTP (Promise to Pay) conversion and kept rates  
● Focus on First-Time Delinquent (FTD) customers to reduce future NPAs  
● Ensure productivity metrics such as calls, RPC (Right Party Contact), and CE% are met  

6. Compliance & Governance  
● Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines and regulatory standards  
● Handle escalations and customer grievances effectively  
● Maintain ethical and compliant recovery practices  
● Support internal and external audit requirements  

7. MIS, Analytics & Reporting  
● Track and analyze KPIs: CE%, RPC, PTP, dialer metrics, and resolution ratios  
● Manage large portfolio data and generate actionable insights  
● Identify gaps in collection strategies and recommend improvements  
● Present performance reports and insights to senior management.  

8. Key Skills & Competencies  
● Strong expertise in collections strategy (early & late buckets)  
● Proven leadership experience managing large teams and vendors  
● Analytical mindset with strong MIS and reporting skills  
● Knowledge of RBI regulations and compliance frameworks  
● Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills  



● Ability to drive performance in high-pressure, target-driven environments

Title: Business Head – F&O

About Us

Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company. Our platform offers a wide range of payment solutions to consumers and merchants, including utility payments, money transfers, and Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) such as Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, and Paytm Payments Bank Net-Banking. We also provide merchant services, advertising, and a Mini app store. With a focus on growth and engagement, we leverage data science to drive sustainable success. We offer credit services sourced from financial partners to further support merchants.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven Business Head – F&O to lead the Futures & Options business for Paytm Money. This role will own the F&O business strategy, P&L, product roadmap, growth initiatives, and customer lifecycle. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Analytics, Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams to drive business growth, improve trader engagement, and strengthen Paytm Money's position in the derivatives market.

Own the F&O business P&L and drive key business metrics including MTUs, retention, premium turnover market share, and ARPU.

Drive lifecycle marketing and engagement initiatives to improve trader activation, retention, and wallet share.
Monitor business performance through dashboards, metrics, and experiment-led decision making.
Track competition, market trends, and SEBI/exchange regulations to adapt business strategies.

Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to execute strategic initiatives and achieve business growth targets.

5+ years of experience in the stock broking industry with strong expertise in the F&O/Derivatives business.

Experience in Product Management, Business Management, Growth, or Product Marketing within the broking or fintech ecosystem.
Proven track record of driving business metrics such as MTUs, retention, premium turnover, ARPU, or revenue growth.
Strong analytical skills with experience in business reporting, cohort analysis, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
Good understanding of the Indian broking landscape, discount brokerage models, and SEBI regulations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and execution skills.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is preferred.

Build and scale one of India's fastest-growing F&O businesses.

Be part of an organization shaping the future of investing and wealth creation for millions of Indians.

Location: Noida

About Paytm

Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.
Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics.
The Inference and Agentic AI team operates as a cross functional unit spanning engineering, product, data science, business management, and sales, and owns the full lifecycle of AI solutions from opportunity discovery to deployment and scale.

Role Overview

Paytm is looking to hire a Client Onboarding Director to own implementation delivery and client onboarding governance for Paytm’s AI Inference and Agentic AI products across enterprise clients.
This is a managerial role that will lead Client Onboarding Managers and ensure that enterprise deployments move smoothly from sales closure to go live and early adoption.
The role sits at the intersection of client teams, product, engineering, business, and sales, and is responsible for converting signed enterprise deals into successful, timely, and scalable deployments.
The candidate will own delivery planning, integration governance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and post go live stabilization across enterprise AI agent deployments.
The role requires strong program management, technical understanding, client handling, and ability to drive execution across multiple internal and external teams.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Ownership and Implementation Governance
Own end to end delivery governance for enterprise AI agent deployments from sales handoff to go live and stabilization.
Lead the implementation planning process across scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success metrics.
Ensure every enterprise deployment has a clear project plan, ownership structure, escalation path, and delivery cadence.
Track deployment progress across multiple clients and ensure timely resolution of blockers.
Drive consistency in delivery quality, client communication, and implementation standards across the onboarding team.
Client Onboarding and Integration Management
Oversee client onboarding across product configuration, data source integration, CRM integration, communication channel setup, user training, and adoption readiness.
Work with Client Onboarding Managers to understand client systems, databases, architecture, workflows, and integration requirements.
Coordinate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical dependencies are resolved on time.
Review integration plans, data readiness, testing plans, and go live checklists for enterprise deployments.
Ensure smooth handoff from pre sales and sales teams into delivery, with clear scope and success criteria.
Client Stakeholder Management
Act as senior delivery owner for enterprise clients during onboarding and implementation.
Manage senior client stakeholders across business, product, technology, data, marketing, and operations teams.
Conduct steering committee reviews, project status updates, and escalation discussions with client teams.
Ensure clients are trained, enabled, and set up to realize early value from Paytm AI agents.
Maintain high client confidence through structured communication, transparency, and timely issue resolution.
Risk, Issue, and Escalation Management
Identify delivery risks early across scope, integrations, timelines, data readiness, client dependencies, and product gaps.
Build mitigation plans and escalation mechanisms to avoid deployment delays.
Run root cause analysis for delivery delays, failed integrations, adoption gaps, or client escalations.
Work with product, engineering, pre sales, and business teams to resolve critical issues.
Maintain clear documentation of risks, decisions, open items, dependencies, and closure actions.
Process, Playbooks, and Scalability
Build standard onboarding playbooks, project templates, go live checklists, training material, and implementation SOPs.
Define delivery metrics such as time to onboard, milestone adherence, integration success rate, client readiness, go live success, and early adoption.
Create dashboards and review cadences to track implementation health across enterprise clients.
Improve onboarding processes continuously through post implementation reviews and client feedback.
Build scalable delivery systems that reduce dependency on individuals and improve implementation quality at scale.
Team Leadership and Cross Functional Collaboration
Lead and mentor Client Onboarding Managers across enterprise delivery workstreams.
Set clear goals, delivery standards, review mechanisms, and quality expectations for the onboarding team.
Work closely with Enterprise GTM, Pre Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, and Support teams.
Ensure clean handoffs across pre sales, sales, onboarding, support, and account management.
Build team capability in client communication, technical understanding, project management, and issue resolution.

Ideal Candidate Profile

8 to 10 years of experience in implementation delivery, customer onboarding, program management, customer success, solutions delivery, or enterprise technology roles.
Experience leading implementation or onboarding teams for SaaS, fintech, CRM, marketing technology, AI, automation, cloud, data platforms, or enterprise software products.
Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, enterprise architecture, CRM systems, and deployment lifecycle.
Proven ability to manage enterprise client stakeholders and drive multi stakeholder implementation programs.
Strong program management skills with ability to manage multiple deployments, timelines, dependencies, and escalations.
Experience building delivery playbooks, SOPs, dashboards, review cadences, and implementation governance systems.
Strong communication and problem solving skills with ability to work across client, product, engineering, sales, and business teams.
High ownership mindset with comfort operating in fast moving and ambiguous environments.
Interest in AI agents, LLMs, automation, analytics, and enterprise digital transformation.

Skills and Qualifications

Strong implementation delivery and program management skills for enterprise technology products.
Good understanding of APIs, data integrations, CRM systems, databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise workflows.
Ability to build project plans, dependency trackers, risk logs, go live checklists, SOPs, and executive status updates.
Strong client communication skills with ability to manage senior stakeholders and escalations.
Strong team leadership skills with ability to manage Client Onboarding Managers and drive delivery discipline.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with ability to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
Comfort with tools such as Google Sheets, Slides, project management tools, documentation platforms, CRM tools, and AI enabled productivity tools.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA or technical postgraduate degree is a plus.

Educational Qualification

Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL).

Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?

Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.

• Use data to assess the impact of risk policies and strategies on portfolio growth, credit quality, and profitability.

• Perform data mining and analysis using SQL, Hive, Metabase, Python, and other relevant data tools.

• Build and implement basic scorecards, analytical frameworks, and risk rules in Business Rules Engines (BRE).

• Apply knowledge of PD, EAD, and LGD models to understand and evaluate Expected Credit Loss (ECL) and portfolio-level credit risk.

• Present insights, recommendations, and risk perspectives clearly and compellingly to senior stakeholders, both verbally and in written form.

• Work in a fast-paced environment, independently drive projects, and solve ambiguous business and risk problems using first-principles thinking.

• Leverage AI tools in day-to-day analytics, problem-solving, and productivity workflows.

What you will need
• 3.5 years to 8 years of relevant experience is required.

• Hands-on experience managing or analyzing portfolios in BNPL, Personal Loans, or other unsecured digital lending businesses.

• Strong understanding of credit risk metrics and portfolio performance, including DPD buckets, roll rates, vintage curves, GNPA/NPA, collection efficiency, approval rates, losses, and portfolio yield.

• Strong RCA, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.

• Strong understanding of PD, EAD, and LGD modelling and their application in Expected Credit Loss (ECL).

• Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience with data-mining tools/systems such as Hive, Metabase, or equivalent databases.

• Hands-on experience with Python, including data wrangling, basic scorecard development, and implementing/coding risk rules in BRE.

• Ability to work effectively with Business, Product, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate and influence risk decisions using data and structured thinking.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with ambiguity.

• MBA, Engineering, or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work and problem-solving, relevant experience in Credit Risk, Risk Analytics, Credit Risk Policy, or Decision Science, preferably within digital lending.

About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.

What you will do
•
Own a workstream end to end: decide which problems are worth solving, set and drive its roadmap, and be accountable for the movement of its metrics.

•
Formulate complex, loosely defined business problems in network design, routing, scheduling, allocation and capacity planning as LP, MILP, MINLP or constraint programming models, with explicit assumptions.

•
Solve them at scale with decomposition (Benders, Lagrangian relaxation, column generation, branch-and-price), heuristics and metaheuristics (large neighbourhood search, ALNS, tabu search) and constraint programming, within real planning-time budgets.

•
Handle uncertainty with stochastic, robust and chance-constrained optimisation, and test decisions through simulation before they reach the ground.

•
Combine OR with ML and DL, such as demand and volume forecasting, ETA prediction and learned heuristics, wherever it improves the decision.

•
Write production-grade code and work with engineering to ship solvers and models into systems that run every day, with testing, monitoring and reproducible pipelines. Use AI coding agents as part of how you build, and verify the formulations, code and results they produce.

•
Mentor DS1s and DS2s on formulation, modelling craft and code quality; align the roadmap with product, engineering, operations and business; and explain trade-offs to senior leaders in decision terms.

•
Publish your work at A* conferences and journals, as part of a team with a highly innovative work culture.

What you will need
•
Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field.

•
5–8 years of experience (or 3+ years with a PhD) applying operations research to real-world problems, with optimisation models deployed in production.

•
Deep expertise in mathematical optimisation (LP, MILP, network flows, integer and combinatorial optimisation), with a proven ability to formulate ambiguous problems, design heuristics, and break complex problems into simpler sub-problems.

•
Experience with large-scale solution methods (decomposition, column generation, heuristics and metaheuristics, constraint programming) and with optimisation under uncertainty and simulation.

•
Hands-on experience with solvers and modelling tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools (including CP-SAT), HiGHS, Pyomo or PuLP.

•
Strong programming: expert Python and SQL, PySpark or similar for large datasets, and solid software engineering (object-oriented design, Git, testing, code review). Fluency with AI coding agents, with the judgement to check their output.

•
Working knowledge of ML and DL (forecasting, regression, tree-based models, neural networks) and of how to combine them with optimisation.

•
Experience leading a workstream and mentoring junior data scientists, and the ability to explain trade-offs and limitations to senior business and operations leaders.

Good to Have:

•
Domain experience in logistics, e-commerce, transportation or supply chain: network design, line haul, vehicle routing (including time windows) or last-mile delivery.

•
Experience with deep learning based forecasting, learning-augmented optimisation (ML for combinatorial optimisation, reinforcement learning) or GPU-accelerated optimisation.

•
Performance-critical programming in C++, Java or Julia, and familiarity with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud.

•
Publications at OR/ML venues (e.g. INFORMS, Transportation Science, Operations Research, NeurIPS, ICML, KDD) or open-source contributions.

Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
About Role
This role is for a sales leader who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about selling AI-led offerings, and can operate at the intersection of AI, services, and enterprise problem-solving. You'll own the NCR region end-to-end — not just the last mile.
This is not a role where you wait for a handed-off, qualified deal. Our internal team owns top-of-funnel prospecting, but you're expected to get your hands dirty across the first and middle mile too — opening doors yourself when a target account needs it, staying close to discovery and org-mapping on your region's marquee deals, and not just parachuting in for the close. You're the face of MAS in North India: building trust with CXOs and BU heads, running the room in high-stakes conversations, owning the commercial close, and building the regional team and playbook as you go.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for the same reason: sellers never get deep enough into an account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. Closing that gap — real discovery, real stakeholder mapping, real champions inside the account — is as much a part of this role as the close itself.

Own and drive deal closure for MAS's enterprise/mid-market book across NCR — from qualified conversation to signed contract.

Build and nurture senior relationships with CXOs, BU heads, and key decision-makers as the primary face of MAS in North India.

Personally lead high-stakes discovery, solutioning, and commercial negotiation on the region's flagship deals — and be willing to self-source, cold-call, or open a door directly when a priority account needs it, rather than waiting only on the central lead-gen team.

Own pricing strategy and structuring for the region — guaranteed-savings and outcome-based models, slab-based and pilot structures — and negotiate terms to closure while holding the line on our pricing floor rather than discounting to close.

Run structured, MEDDPICC-style account qualification on every live deal, so you have an honest diagnosis of why a deal is stuck rather than just a stage in a pipeline.

Guide and unblock deals being run by the region's junior GTM talent — reviewing discovery notes, org maps, and pricing approaches, and stepping in directly when a deal stalls.

Coach and develop junior GTM generalists in the region on discovery, stakeholder mapping, and pricing fundamentals, building a bench for future sales leadership (note: depending on how the team structure evolves, some of these hires may report directly into this role, others into the VP Sales).

Identify product and service gaps through client conversations and feed insights back to Product, Tech, and Ops.

•
Own the demo and proposal narrative for regional deals — refining what we show, how we show it, and why it resonates with senior stakeholders.

•
Track competition and market positioning in North India, and adapt the sales/commercial playbook accordingly.

Represent MAS at regional forums and industry conversations to build brand and pipeline as the region — and your remit — grows.

About Meesho 
 
Mission and Vision 
 
Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, driven by the mission to democratize internet commerce for everyone (DICE). Our vision is to enable 100 million small businesses and entrepreneurs in India to succeed online, making online commerce accessible to all. This core purpose guides us in empowering sellers across the country and bringing a diverse range of products to first-time internet shoppers. By leveraging technology and a unique zero commission model, Meesho has opened the doors of e-commerce to millions who were previously underserved. 
 
Technological Scale & Innovation
 
 At Meesho, technology is at the heart of our success. We have invested in a scalable infrastructure and innovative solutions to meet the demands of a vast user base and complex marketplace. Some key highlights include: 
 
Massive Scale: Our backend systems handle millions of orders per day from across India, reaching about 5% of all Indian households, all with near-zero downtime to date. Achieving this level of reliability and performance in a hyper-growth environment is a testament to our engineering excellence. 
 
 Marketplace Reach: Over 1.75 million sellers are registered on Meesho’s platform, supported by our state-of-the-art tech infrastructure and pan-India logistics network. This wide reach — covering virtually every serviceable pin code in the country — presents unique engineering challenges in areas like search, personalization, and payments at scale.
 
 Scalable Architecture: We continually innovate our architecture for growth.. Our quest to serve a billion Indian users has helped us evolve our technologies from a monolith to microservices to now a high scale federated architecture. This evolution allows us to build and deploy features rapidly while maintaining stability for a fast-growing user base. 
 
Cutting-edge Tech Stack: Our platform is built using modern, open-source technologies on the cloud while ensuring high efficiency. We strategically choose proven tools (for example, Java and Golang for services, Kafka for messaging, Dragonfly and Redis for caching, ScyllaDB, MySQL and Mongo for Data) and leverage GCP infrastructure to ensure high performance, reliability, and flexibility. By focusing on the right tools for the right problems, we innovate pragmatically rather than chasing every new tech hype, which helps us solve real-world problems effectively. 
 
Engineering Culture & Challenges 
 
Engineering at Meesho is driven by a bold and inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe that building great products goes hand-in-hand with building a great team. Key aspects of our engineering culture include: 
 
Long Term Thinking: We believe in thinking for tomorrow while building for today, this approach has helped us not only to handle and evolve for scale but also focus on extensibility and stability by investing in the platform
 
Lightspeed: We prioritize rapid iteration and delivery. Engineers are encouraged to ship fast and refine continuously, as we value in order to learn and adapt quickly. 
 
Continuous Improvement: We view failures and bugs as opportunities to improve. A blameless post-mortem culture ensures that mistakes become lessons, fostering an environment where learning from failure drives resilience and innovation.
 
 Ownership Mindset: Every engineer is empowered to act like an owner. We instill a “Founder’s Mindset,” encouraging engineers to take end-to-end ownership of projects and drive them with an entrepreneurial spirit. This means our teams proactively identify problems and champion solutions, just as a founder would for their own product. 
 
Engineering at Meesho is more than just writing code – it's about solving complex, impactful problems at an unprecedented scale. Our engineers tackle challenging use cases (from enabling real-time logistics across India to optimizing a vast product catalog for the next billion users), making a tangible impact on millions of entrepreneurs and customers. We maintain a
professional, yet passionate work environment where the drive to innovate is balanced with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

We are looking for Engineering Manager well-versed with emerging technologies to join our team.
 As an Engineering Manager, you will ensure consistency and quality by shaping the right strategies. You will keep an eye on all engineering projects and ensure all duties are fulfilled . You will analyse other employees’ tasks and carry on collaborations effectively. You will also transform newbies into experts and build reports on the progress of all projects.

What you will do
• Design tasks for other engineers as per Meesho’s guidelines

• Perform regular performance evaluation and share and seek feedback

• Keep a closer look on various projects and monitor the progress

• Carry on smooth collaborations with the sales team and design teams to innovate on new products

• Manage engineers and take ownership of the project while ensuring product scalability

• Conduct regular meetings to plan and develop reports on the progress of projects

What you will need
• Bachelor's/Master’s in computer science

• At least 7+ years professional experience

• At least 2 years of experience in managing software development teams

• Able to drive sprints and OKRs

• Deep understanding of transactional and NoSQL DBs

• Deep understanding of Messaging systems – Kafka

• Good experience on cloud infrastructure - AWS/GCS

• Good to have: Data pipelines, ES

• Exceptional team managing skills; experience in building large scale distributed Systems

• Experience in Scalable Systems

• Expertise in Java/Python and multithreading

We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. As Engineering Manager, you will be part of self-starters who thrive on teamwork and constructive feedback. We know how to party as hard as we work! If we aren’t building unparalleled tech solutions, you can find us debating the plot points of our favourite books and games – or even gossiping over chai. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
 
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

fields.title: Head (Senior Manager) - Industrial Relations
fields.skills_required: Operations Management, Advanced Excel, Project Coordination, Reporting
fields.description:
About the Team
You will join the Security & Investigations team within Fulfilment & Experience (F&E) at Meesho. F&E is the operational and technological backbone powering India's cost-efficient, reliable and scalable e-commerce network, serving 100M+ monthly active users. From enabling Valmo's distributed logistics network to building scalable fulfilment and experience platforms, F&E operates at the intersection of technology, operations and network innovation.
Within F&E, the Security & Investigations team safeguards the integrity and resilience of this network. The team investigates shipment loss, pilferage, fraud and misconduct, oversees physical security across operating sites, and coordinates with law enforcement and other stakeholders where required. Working closely with Operations, HR, Legal and logistics partners, the team helps keep the network secure, compliant and resilient.
About the Role
Valmo's operating network is powered by a large and diverse workforce spanning sort centres, hubs and last-mile operations. A significant portion of this workforce is engaged through logistics partners and other workforce arrangements, creating a complex industrial-relations environment across multiple locations and states.
As Head – Industrial Relations, you will own the Industrial Relations (IR) charter for the operating network, within the Security & Investigations function, and work closely with HR, Legal, Operations and partner leadership. Your mandate will be to build a stable, compliant and scalable workforce-relations framework that prevents avoidable disputes, enables fair and timely resolution of workforce issues, and provides strong governance when matters escalate.
The role combines strategic IR leadership with significant field engagement. You will build early-warning mechanisms, manage worker and union relationships, oversee dispute and disciplinary processes, strengthen partner workforce compliance, engage with labour authorities, and create playbooks and governance mechanisms that can scale with the network.

What You Will Do
Own IR strategy and governance. Build and continuously evolve a national IR framework covering workforce relations, grievance management, dispute prevention, statutory compliance, worker/union engagement, escalation and resolution.

Build workforce intelligence and early-warning mechanisms. Track workforce sentiment, grievances, absenteeism, wage-related concerns, shift and working-condition issues, emerging worker representation or union activity, and other indicators of potential disruption across the network.

Prevent and manage industrial disputes. Develop structured approaches to prevent disputes and lead the response to strikes, work stoppages, protests, gheraos and other workforce disruptions. Engage with worker representatives and union leaders and coordinate with Operations, HR, Legal, partners, local administration, labour authorities and law enforcement, as appropriate.

Bring IR rigour to investigations. Partner with Security & Investigations, HR and Legal on cases involving employees or partner workers, including theft, fraud, misconduct and policy violations. Ensure due process, appropriate documentation and legally sound decision-making.

Govern disciplinary processes. Oversee show-cause notices, domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions, ensuring that processes are fair, consistent, timely and legally defensible under applicable law, standing orders and organisational policy.

Drive partner workforce compliance. Establish and monitor governance over logistics partners covering contract labour requirements, wage and benefits compliance, statutory registrations, working hours, worker documentation, grievance mechanisms and other applicable labour requirements. Drive timely corrective action and escalation where gaps are identified.

Own government and authority engagement. Build effective working relationships with labour departments, labour commissioners, conciliation officers and other relevant government authorities. Represent the organisation in inspections, conciliation proceedings and hearings, in partnership with Legal, and coordinate with Security on matters requiring law-enforcement engagement.

Build effective grievance and escalation channels. Design and strengthen mechanisms such as worker helplines, site-level committees, grievance forums and escalation paths so that workforce concerns are surfaced and resolved before they become formal disputes.

Create scalable IR playbooks and capability. Develop SOPs, policies, escalation matrices and response playbooks for dispute management, investigation-linked disciplinary action, partner workforce issues and authority engagement. Train site leaders, partner supervisors, HR teams and security personnel on relevant IR practices and labour-law basics.

Build IR analytics and leadership reporting. Establish dashboards and regular reviews covering incidents, disputes, grievances, compliance health, partner risks, resolution timelines, repeat issues and emerging trends. Translate these into clear insights and actions for senior leadership.

Strengthen cross-functional governance. Establish clear interfaces between IR, HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and partner leadership, including decision rights, escalation threshold

What You Will Need
• 8–15 years of experience in industrial relations, employee relations, labour relations or labour-law compliance, preferably in large, distributed workforce environments.

• Experience in logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, infrastructure or other large blue-collar and/or contract-workforce environments is strongly preferred.

• Deep working knowledge of applicable Indian labour and employment laws, including the Labour Codes and associated rules/notifications, contract labour requirements, industrial disputes, standing orders and relevant state-specific requirements.

• Practical experience applying labour law and IR principles on the ground across multiple sites and, ideally, multiple states.

• Proven experience handling industrial disputes, worker grievances, union/worker representative engagement, negotiations, strikes or work stoppages.

• Experience conducting or overseeing domestic enquiries and disciplinary proceedings, with a strong understanding of how employee investigations intersect with employment law and due process.

• Experience managing contract labour or partner workforce compliance, including audits, statutory requirements, wage-related compliance and remediation.

• Strong ability to engage with labour authorities, conciliation officers and other government stakeholders, preferably with experience representing an organisation in formal proceedings.

• Strong negotiation, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to remain calm, credible and objective in high-pressure situations.

• Ability to work effectively across HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and external partners, with sound judgement on ownership, escalation and confidentiality.

• Strong communication skills in English and Hindi. Proficiency in one or more regional languages is an advantage, particularly for workforce-heavy operating regions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, including the ability to use workforce and incident data to identify patterns, risks and preventive actions.

• Willingness to travel extensively across operating locations and respond to sensitive on-ground situations at short notice.

• High integrity, discretion and maturity, with the ability to handle confidential matters and decisions that can materially affect employees and workers.

• A degree in law, HR, labour welfare, social work or a related discipline (LLB, MSW, MBA-HR or equivalent) is preferred.

Role Characteristics

• National scope with significant field engagement across the operating network.

• High level of cross-functional and external stakeholder interaction.

• Combination of strategic programme ownership, operational problem-solving and on-ground dispute management.

• Requires sound judgement, neutrality, confidentiality and the ability to balance business continuity with fair and compliant workforce practices.

The Commerce Platform team at Meesho drives end-to-end growth, strategy, and operational excellence across key verticals:
User Growth: Scales the full lifecycle funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention. The User Growth team also houses Meesho’s branding pods, which shape how Bharat sees, trusts and keeps coming back to Meesho.
Marketplace: Focuses on strengthening the seller ecosystem and improving selection quality to create a robust and reliable marketplace experience.
Category: Identifies high-potential segments, launches and scales new categories, and drives assortment expansion to meet evolving customer demand.
Mall: Builds a trusted branded destination for quality-conscious users, enhancing the platform’s premium and branded shopping experience.
Pricing: Ensures competitiveness and affordability, enabling the platform to deliver strong value for customers while maintaining marketplace health.
Content Commerce: Powers content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven shopping journeys that drive engagement, trust, and conversion.

Operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, the team combines structured problem-solving with rapid execution to deliver meaningful impact.

MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.

We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.

Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.

Run structured discovery conversations to understand a client's real pain points, current workflows, and AI-readiness.

Make cold calls and run client meetings yourself where needed, working alongside (not just waiting on) the central lead-gen team.

Own the follow-up cadence after every client conversation — chasing next steps, addressing objections, and making sure momentum doesn't drop.

Build a working understanding of MAS's guaranteed-savings and outcome-based pricing models (per-minute, slab-based, pilot, risk-sharing) and contribute early pricing inputs on deals you're driving.

•
Brief and prep senior closers ahead of high-stakes conversations — sharp account context, clear stakeholder maps, clear next steps.

•
Bonus: build and iterate on client-specific product demos in partnership with Product/Tech.

•
Feed client and market insights back into the sales playbook and to Product, Tech, and Ops.

•
Bring structured, consultative thinking to every account rather than a transactional, task-based approach.

What you will need
•
4–7 years of experience in enterprise sales, GTM, business consulting, or client-facing analyst/BD roles, ideally with exposure to Indian mid-market/enterprise clients.

•
Strong discovery and analytical skills — able to quickly and accurately unpack a client's business problem and current workflow.

•
Comfort making cold calls and running early client meetings — this is not a purely inbound or coordination role.

•
A structured communicator — able to produce crisp meeting notes, account maps, and follow-up briefs.

•
Basic commercial acumen — able to understand and reason about pricing structures (you won't be expected to own pricing negotiations independently yet).

•
Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology — you don't need to code, but you should "get it."

•
Exposure to (or curiosity about) structured account-qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC is a plus — we'll teach you the specifics.

•
High ownership and follow-through — comfortable chasing a deal over weeks or months without losing momentum.

•
Comfortable working in ambiguity, without established playbooks, in a 0–1/1–10 business environment.

•
Ambition to grow — either toward a full closing/sales-leadership role, or into Business/GTM Operations — over time.

•
Bonus: prior exposure to building or presenting product demos.

•
Evidence that you're genuinely top-tier talent — that might show up as academic pedigree (a strong record at a top institute) or as a professional track record (success at a recognizable brand, or a reputation for excellence in high-stakes client work). We care about the evidence of excellence, not which box it comes from.

The role will manage a team of 6 direct reports supporting office, work-from-home, and field-based employees across multiple businesses and locations. The incumbent will partner closely with Business Leaders, HR Leadership, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Payroll, Ethics and Investigations, and staffing partners.

•
Partner with Business Leaders and Finance teams on workforce planning, headcount budgeting, organizational design, productivity, cost optimization, and workforce deployment.

•
Maintain visibility on headcount, hiring, vacancies, redeployments, contract renewals, non-renewals, attrition, organizational structure, and workforce costs.

•
Partner with managers on performance management, talent development, succession planning, retention, and performance improvement plans.

•
Use workforce data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities and recommend appropriate business and people interventions.

•
Lead the Employee Relations charter across businesses and locations, ensuring fair, consistent, and timely resolution of employee concerns.

•

•
Lead or oversee workplace investigations, including complaint assessment, interviews, evidence review, documentation, findings, and recommendations.

•

•
Guide HRBPs and managers on grievance handling, corrective action, disciplinary processes, performance concerns, and sensitive employee conversations.

•
Ensure ER decisions follow organizational policies, applicable laws, principles of natural justice, and established precedents.

•
Provide governance oversight for hiring, onboarding, background verification, attendance, payroll inputs, insurance, contract renewals, and exits.

•
Monitor compliance with minimum wages, statutory requirements, labour laws, contractor obligations, and internal policies.

•
Conduct periodic audits, review vendor performance, and strengthen SOPs, controls, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.

•
Lead, coach, and develop six direct reports across the HRBP and ER charters, with clear goals, accountability, and operating rhythms.

•
Build team capability in business partnering, investigations, documentation, data analysis, labour-law compliance, and stakeholder management.

•
Review key deliverables and escalations while enabling team members to independently manage their respective businesses and responsibilities.

What you will need
•
6 - 10 years of progressive HR experience, with significant exposure to both HR Business Partnering and Employee Relations.

•
Experience managing a large, distributed contract, third-party, fixed-term, field, operations, or high-volume workforce.

•
Proven experience handling complex ER cases, workplace investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, performance concerns, and fraud-related matters.

•
Strong experience partnering with senior leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, performance, talent, and attrition.

•
Good understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, minimum wages, contractor governance, and audit requirements.

•
Experience managing staffing partners and governing employee-lifecycle processes.

•
Prior experience leading and developing an HRBP or ER team is essential.

•
Strong stakeholder management, communication, conflict resolution, investigation, documentation, and data-analysis capabilities.

•
Sound judgment, high ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to handle confidential matters independently.

•
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and high-pressure environment.

•
Willingness to travel and support teams across multiple locations.

•
MBA/PGDM or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Human Resources. Certification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, POSH, or workplace investigations will be an added advantage.
