Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing the financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance! Financial Services (FS) is one of the fastest growing new businesses at Meesho. It's a large 10X opportunity for Meesho to build financial products for Bharat users and serve the unmet needs of millions of our users. And you will be at the center of this journey, building and scaling the business and serving millions of Meesho users. Meesho FS has several lines of products primarily in lending space for users and sellers of Meesho.

We aspire to create one of the country’s largest financial services businesses, drawing inspiration from global giants such as Alibaba, Shopee, and Mercado Libre, who have thrived in markets comparable to India and built large financial businesses.

About the Role

In this role, you will own the growth and governance of Meesho's Bank and NBFC partnerships across lending. Your first priority will be to scale existing partnerships by improving funnel performance, monitoring portfolio and risk, and deepening partner relationships. You will also lead new-partner integrations end to end, establish standard and increasingly automated operating processes, and build a qualified pipeline of new partners aligned with the supply roadmap. The role requires close collaboration with growth, credit risk, collections, product, technology, legal, compliance, finance, and operations teams to deliver timely launches and stable scale-up.

• First principles based critical thinking and data-led approach to problem-solving

• A rare opportunity to build a large scale financial services business for millions of users

• Collaborate and drive growth of some of the latest fintech products and innovations

• End to end responsibility and ownership

• Once in a lifetime opportunity to create impact at scale

• Strong employee-friendly policies

• A fun and supportive team and leadership

Being part of Meesho's Fulfillment and Experience (F&E) team as Manager will zip you to the cockpit of our ever-burgeoning rocketship and, you’ll shape the experience of Bharat’s next billion e-commerce users. We’re an eclectic mix of over 100 professionals, all driven by the first principles of problem-solving. We come with diverse skill sets and responsibilities ranging from running operations/support to managing the supply chain, and maintaining analytics to ensure the best possible user and seller experience. At Meesho, we are on a mission to achieve what has never been done before – introducing e-commerce to the tier-2 and tier-3 cities of India. Our team's crucial contribution to this ambitious endeavor involves completely reimagining fulfillment from the ground up. This translates into a multitude of "zero-to-one" projects, offering opportunities for those willing to seize them. Our focus is on constructing a supply chain and user experience that reshapes the landscape of e-commerce. Simultaneously, we are unwavering in our commitment to introducing best-in-class processes and policies, coupled with a steadfast dedication to continuous innovation. The ultimate goal is to consistently deliver excellence in both User and Seller experiences. Emphasizing personal growth and enjoyment at work is integral to our culture, just as much as our dedication to hard work. Join us in this exciting journey where innovation meets personal and professional development!

Our Data Science team is the Avengers to Meesho’s S.H.I.E.L.D 🛡️. And why not? We’ve barely scratched the surface, and have amazing challenges in charting the future of commerce for Bharat.  
 
 
About the Role
 
As a Principal Data Scientist in our AdTech team, you’ll drive innovation in our advertising platform using advanced machine learning and statistical methods. You’ll tackle complex problems in real-time bidding, ad ranking optimization, budget efficiency, and performance measurement that directly impact our business’s bottom line. This role requires technical excellence and business acumen and you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform data insights into actionable strategies that enhance our advertising ecosystem.

• Design and develop sophisticated bidding, budget pacing and other algorithms that optimize ad spend or ROI.

• Create frameworks and experimental design to measure ad effectiveness and ROI.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into efficient AI/ML solutions.

• Mentor junior data scientists and provide technical guidance.

• Lead research initiatives in machine learning, auction theory and advertising technology.

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
 
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
 
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
 
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.

fields.description:
Security Architect - AI-Powered Security Engineering
About the Team
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. When 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this, with zero downtime! We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. By 2030, Meesho will be the world’s most trusted and secure digital ecosystem, operating on an AI-native, Zero-Trust, self-healing architecture. As we shift toward an era where autonomous agents generate and deploy code, we want to ensure our security scales seamlessly with engineering velocity. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member, fostering a strong 'Founder’s Mindset' that helps us move fast.
About the Role
We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Security Architect (Individual Contributor) to guide and lead our AI-Powered Security Engineering charter. In this role, you will bridge the gap between conventional DevSecOps, infrastructure security, and the rapidly evolving landscape of AI. You will optimize our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by designing secure-by-default guardrails for both human developers and AI coding agents. Your mission is to ensure near-zero vulnerabilities from application and data security failures reach production. A significant portion of your focus will involve advanced Red Teaming, utilizing LLMs to improve Meesho's security posture, and architecting defenses for our autonomous AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, and jailbreaking attacks.

What You Will Do
•
Lead AI Security Architecture: Drive the technical roadmap and high-level design to continuously prevent, detect, and autonomously contain threats across our systems and AI agents.

•
Hands-on Prototyping & POCs: Build proof-of-concepts for autonomous agent harnesses that automatically detect, analyze, and mitigate security vulnerabilities in real-time.

•
AI SDLC Optimization: Architect non-bypassable security guardrails across the SDLC for both developers and AI coding agents to ensure production systems are secured by default.

•
Red Teaming & Adversarial Validation: Proactively execute adversarial testing by simulating real attack scenarios across APIs, AI systems, and infrastructure to validate defense mechanisms.

•
Protect AI Systems: Design deep technical defenses to protect all AI agents and experimental features from prompt injection, system misuse, manipulation, and unauthorized actions.

•
Zero-Trust Governance: Architect a Zero Trust Identity Control Plane that eliminates implicit trust, ensuring access for both humans and autonomous agents is time-bound, least-privileged, and continuously verified.

•
Technical Leadership & Influence: Act as a security expert and IC leader. Mentor security engineers, provide architectural guidance across the organization, and partner closely with ML, DevOps, and Platform teams to evangelize secure coding practices without direct reporting lines.

What You Will Need
•
Experience: 10+ years of hands-on technical experience across different areas of security, including infrastructure security, product security, system design, and DevSecOps.

•
AI/ML Security Expertise: Proven track record of leveraging coding agents and LLMs for security workflows, Red Teaming GenAI models, and building defenses against jailbreaking, adversarial ML, and model hallucination risks.

•
DevSecOps & Cloud Mastery: Deep technical proficiency with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, including their security tools, Docker, and containerization technologies.

•
Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Node.js, and Python, combined with hands-on experience securing production code, developing security tooling, and performing manual source code reviews.

•
Strategic Vision & Threat Modeling: Ability to architect secure-by-default platform capabilities so all services inherit baseline security automatically, paired with advanced threat modeling skills for AI-native and distributed architectures.

Bonus Points

•
Relevant certifications such as GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT) or OffSec’s Advanced Web Attacks and Exploitation (WEB-300).

•
Strong understanding of emerging AI security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF).

•
Experience participating in bug bounty programs or speaking at meetups/conferences.

•
Developing Security products and frameworks.

About the Team
 
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. After all, when 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this – with zero downtime! 😎 Sounds impossible? Well, that’s the kind of Engineering muscle that has helped Meesho become the e-commerce giant it is today. We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. As a Security Engineer, you will be part of self-starters who thrive on teamwork and constructive feedback. We know how to party as hard as we work! If we aren’t building unparalleled tech solutions, you can find us debating the plot points of our favorite books and games – or even gossiping over chai. So, if a day filled with building impactful solutions with a fun team sounds appealing to you, join us.
 
About the Role
 
As a Security Engineer 3 in Infrastructure Security, you are a senior individual contributor who owns Meesho's infrastructure security and security operations (SOC) end to end. You will be one of the engineers securing everything from GCP organisation policy and IAM down to Kubernetes workloads and CI/CD infrastructure, so you will set the technical direction for infrastructure security, not just execute it. You operate with limited supervision, act as the trusted security voice in infrastructure and platform architecture discussions, and partner closely with other engineers whom you will mentor and uplevel. 
The role rewards breadth with depth: you should be comfortable moving between cloud architecture reviews, hands-on hardening, detection engineering, and incident response in the same week, and you will have unusual freedom to automate, consolidate, and build the guardrails that let a lean team secure a platform operating at Meesho's scale.

What you will do
Cloud Security Architecture & Design Review: Own secure design for Meesho's GCP estate, including organisation policies, project structure, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC design, VPC Service Controls, workload identity, and encryption/key management (Cloud KMS). Lead threat modeling and security reviews for new infrastructure and platform services, and drive the resulting requirements into production with platform engineering.

Kubernetes & Container Security: Harden GKE clusters and containerised workloads end to end: cluster configuration, RBAC, network policies, admission control and policy-as-code, workload identity, image provenance and registry controls, and runtime posture. Define the secure-by-default patterns that platform and product teams build on.

Identity & Zero Trust: Drive Meesho's zero-trust roadmap for infrastructure: least-privilege IAM at scale, elimination of long-lived credentials and static keys, just-in-time and break-glass access patterns, secrets management, and strong isolation between production and non-production environments.

Posture Management & Hardening: Own cloud security posture management using GCP-native tooling (Security Command Center) and complementary controls. Continuously find, prioritise, and burn down misconfigurations and attack paths across the estate, and convert recurring findings into preventive guardrails rather than tickets.

Infrastructure as Code & Pipeline Security: Embed security into how infrastructure ships: IaC scanning and policy enforcement (Terraform), CI/CD pipeline hardening, artifact and dependency integrity, and software supply-chain controls for infrastructure components.

SOC & Detection and Response (End-to-End Ownership): Own Meesho's SOC and detection & response function: run the SIEM and the managed detection (MxDR) partner relationship, own alert triage quality, escalation paths, and on-call, and ensure infrastructure telemetry (cloud audit logs, Kubernetes audit, network and identity signals) is onboarded and high-signal. Build and tune detections for cloud-native attack techniques, lead incident response as the senior technical responder, and drive post-incident fixes to architectural closure.

Security Automation: Design and build automation that multiplies a lean team: auto-remediation for common misconfigurations, access-review tooling, inventory and attack-surface mapping, and self-service security workflows for engineering teams.

Vulnerability & Patch Management: Own the vulnerability lifecycle for infrastructure: OS and image patching posture, container base-image management, exposure tracking, and remediation SLAs, with metrics that drive engineering prioritisation.

AI Infrastructure Security: Contribute to securing the infrastructure behind Meesho's AI workloads, including the AI gateway plane, model-access controls, and isolation and egress controls for agents and AI services running in production.

Mentorship & Security Partnership: Mentor the SE2 on the team, review their work, and raise the team's technical bar. Act as the infrastructure security subject-matter expert for platform, SRE, and DevOps teams, influencing decisions without direct authority.

Compliance Enablement: Translate control requirements from frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, the DPDP Act, and CERT-In directions (logging, retention, incident reporting) into pragmatic technical controls, and provide evidence from systems you own.

What you will need
Experience: 5-7 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, cloud, or platform security, with a demonstrated track record of owning security outcomes end to end in a production cloud environment.

Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field is preferred.

Core Technical Depth:

•
Strong hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on GCP (IAM, organisation policy, VPC and VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS, Security Command Center, audit logging); deep AWS or Azure experience with willingness to go deep on GCP also works.

•
Deep, practical Kubernetes security expertise (ideally GKE): RBAC, network policies, admission control, workload identity, image and registry security, and runtime threat detection.

•
Proven ability to lead threat modeling for complex distributed infrastructure and translate findings into controls that ship.

•
Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and with embedding security scanning and policy enforcement into CI/CD.

•
Strong scripting or programming ability (Python or Go preferred) and a bias toward building automation over running manual reviews.

•
Hands-on experience running detection and response: operating a SIEM (ideally with a managed SOC/MxDR partner), knowing what telemetry matters, writing high-signal detections, and leading infrastructure security incidents to closure.

•
Solid grounding in Linux, networking, and identity fundamentals (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, service identity).

General Skills & Acumen:

•
Sound judgment on risk prioritisation at scale: knowing which of a thousand findings actually matter and why.

•
Comfort operating in a lean team: self-directed, pragmatic about scope, and able to drive initiatives to closure across platform, SRE, and DevOps teams without direct authority.

•
Excellent communication skills, able to explain infrastructure risk to both engineers and leadership.

•
Ability and willingness to mentor an earlier-career security engineer.

Bonus Points

•
Relevant certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, OSCP, or GCPN.

•
Experience with zero-trust architecture rollouts or large-scale IAM remediation programmes.

•
Experience operating or integrating with a SIEM/SOC, including detection-as-code practices.

•
Exposure to securing AI/LLM infrastructure (model gateways, agent isolation, egress controls) and software supply-chain security (SLSA, artifact signing).

•
Offensive security exposure: cloud-focused red teaming, attack-path analysis, or published research/CVEs.

•
Exposure to India regulatory requirements such as the DPDP Act and CERT-In directions.

•
Experience speaking at meetups or conferences.

fields.description:
what is CRED?
 
CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better.

About the Role:
 
Zeta is building out its Security Operations Centre function, running on AWS OpenSearch as our core SIEM. We are looking for a SOC L2 Analyst with a strong investigative mindset and hands-on comfort operating without a traditional GUI-driven workflow — this role requires fluency in query languages to search, correlate, and triage data directly.
You'll be one of the early analysts shaping detection and response practices across a modern, cloud-native, hybrid environment spanning Kubernetes microservices, multi-cloud infrastructure, and traditional corporate IT.
 
You will be investigating and monitoring across:
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (primary hosting for all workloads/resources), Azure (logs), Kubernetes microservices
Edge/CDN & Network Security: Cloudflare
Endpoint: Microsoft Defender (corporate IT), macOS endpoints
Primary OS for incidents: Linux (majority of incident volume), with Windows/macOS corporate IT coverage
SIEM: AWS OpenSearch (query-language driven — no dedicated analysis GUI)

Responsibilities:
1. Monitoring & Escalation Handling

• Perform full-time monitoring alongside L1, actively working the alert queue during high-volume periods, while also handling escalations from L1 analysts.

• Act as the primary escalation point for all L1-escalated alerts and incidents; receive and validate escalated alerts/incidents, performing deeper investigation to confirm scope, impact, and root cause.

• Perform detailed investigation, log correlation, and root-cause analysis across multiple data sources — AWS, Kubernetes, Cloudflare, Azure logs, Defender, and Linux/macOS endpoints.

• Write and run OpenSearch Query DSL / Lucene queries directly against raw log data to pivot, correlate, and build full incident timelines (this is the primary analysis method — there is no GUI-driven investigation path).

• Determine incident severity, scope, and business impact; validate true positive vs. false positive at a deeper level.

• Escalate confirmed major/high-severity incidents to the L3/Incident Response team or CSIRT leadership per the incident response plan, including a full technical summary, supporting evidence, and recommended actions.

• Coordinate with L3/Incident Response teams for complex or high-severity incidents.

2. Threat Analysis & Detection Support

• Conduct threat hunting based on IOCs, IOAs, and threat intelligence feeds.

• Support ideation and testing of new detection use cases, correlation rules, and dashboards, in coordination with the detection engineering/L3 team.

• Identify and report logging/health issues (e.g., missing logs, parser errors, data source outages) for timely resolution.

• Tune and recommend improvements to detection rules, correlation logic, and SIEM use cases based on false positives/negatives observed during investigations; develop tested tuning solutions and hand them to L3 analysts and build teams for deployment.

• Create new detection use cases, tune existing correlation rules, build/modify dashboards, develop and refine UEBA rules, and map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework for coverage visibility.

3. Playbook, SOP & Knowledge Management

• Develop and refine investigation steps for scenarios not covered by existing playbooks, and document these as new/updated runbooks for L1 use.

• Update and improve SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base articles based on incident learnings.

4. L1 Oversight & Mentoring

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to L1 analysts, including alert triage decisions and use of investigation tools.

• Own L1 shift handovers, and train/mentor L1 analysts on alert handling and escalation.

• Review quality of L1 alert closures and escalations; provide feedback and coaching.

• Support training and onboarding of L1 analysts on tools, triage procedures, and escalation criteria.

• Ensure smooth shift handovers between L1 and L2, and across shifts.

5. Compliance & Audit Support

• Assist with compliance and audit requests requiring deeper technical evidence or investigation summaries.

6. Continuous Learning & Feedback

• Continuously expand knowledge of emerging threats, attack techniques, and best practices through ongoing training and self-study.

• Stay current on emerging threats, TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to our environment, and translate this into actionable detection improvements.

Skills:
• Strong working knowledge of SIEM query languages — direct experience with OpenSearch Query DSL, Lucene syntax, KQL, SPL, or equivalent is essential (you must be comfortable querying raw data without relying on prebuilt dashboards)

• Solid Linux investigation skills — process, network, and log-level analysis on Linux hosts is core to this role

• Practical understanding of cloud security fundamentals, ideally AWS (IAM, CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, GuardDuty, etc.)

• Exposure to Kubernetes/container security concepts (pod logs, k8s audit logs, common container attack patterns)

• Familiarity with Cloudflare logs (WAF, DNS, edge traffic) or similar CDN/edge security tooling

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender and basic Windows/macOS endpoint investigation

• Strong analytical and investigative mindset — able to pivot from a single alert to a full incident narrative using raw log data

• Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and common attack patterns (cloud, container, endpoint), including mapping detections for coverage visibility

• Experience acting as an escalation point for L1 analysts — validating their triage, coaching on quality, and owning shift handovers

• Ability to author and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles from incident learnings

• Clear, structured incident documentation and communication skills

Experience and Qualifications:
• 3–5 years of hands-on SOC experience, with at least 1–2 years in an L2 analyst capacity handling escalations independently

• Bachelor of Technology (BE/B.Tech), M.Tech/ME in Computer Science or equivalent.

• Prior SOC experience in a fintech, banking, or regulated industry environment

• Exposure to Azure Sentinel/Azure logs in addition to AWS

• Scripting ability (Python, Bash) for automation of repetitive investigation tasks

• Certifications such as Security+, GCIH, GCIA, CySA+, or equivalent

• Experience contributing to detection engineering (writing/tuning correlation rules, not just consuming them)

• Familiarity with case management/ticketing tools (e.g., TheHive, Jira, ServiceNow)

• Experience developing or tuning UEBA rules

• Experience identifying and reporting log pipeline health issues (missing sources, parser errors, ingestion outages)

•
Experience supporting compliance/audit evidence requests (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, RBI/regulatory — relevant to fintech)

Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

About the Role:
As a Cloud Security & DevSecOps Engineer II, you will play a key role in strengthening the security posture of our cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/container platforms and software delivery ecosystem. 
You will work closely with Cloud/Platform, SRE, DevOps, Engineering, Product Security and Risk & Compliance teams to identify and mitigate security risks, build scalable security controls, automate recurring security activities and drive security findings through remediation and closure. 
The role covers Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), IAM & Access Governance, DevSecOps, Kubernetes Security, Infrastructure Security, Vulnerability Management, Security Monitoring, Security Automation and Compliance Engineering, while also contributing to broader Information Security initiatives across the organisation.

Responsibilities
•
Perform continuous security posture assessments across AWS, Azure and GCP environments and identify cloud misconfigurations, insecure configurations and deviations from security baselines.

•
Conduct IAM and SSO access reviews, covering users, roles, groups, service accounts/service principals, permissions, access keys and privileged access, and identify excessive or stale access.

•
Identify and assess publicly exposed cloud resources, insecure network configurations and unnecessary external exposure across compute, storage, databases, load balancers and other cloud services.

•
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, Infrastructure-as-Code scanning, container/image scanning, DAST and software supply-chain controls.

•
Perform Infrastructure-as-Code security reviews and support secure implementation of Terraform and similar technologies.

•
Perform Kubernetes and container security assessments, including cluster configurations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload security, image security, hardening and security posture management.

•
Analyse vulnerabilities and security findings, validate risks and false positives, prioritise remediation and work with Engineering/SRE/DevOps teams to drive findings through closure.

•
Develop security automation using Python, Bash, cloud APIs and CLIs for IAM reviews, asset inventories, security assessments, compliance checks, monitoring, reporting and evidence collection.

•
Review cloud network and edge security controls including VPC/VNet, Security Groups/firewalls, load balancers, WAF, TLS/mTLS and public/private connectivity.

•
Monitor and review CloudSEK alerts and findings, perform initial analysis and validation, and coordinate remediation or escalation with relevant stakeholders.

•
Support CloudSEK block-rule activities, including review and validation of relevant indicators, domains and URLs, and coordinate appropriate blocking actions with responsible teams.

•
Support investigation of cloud and security alerts, exposed credentials, suspicious access, provider security notifications and other security events.

•
Participate in cloud architecture and design security reviews and provide practical security recommendations based on risk, secure-by-design and least-privilege principles.

•
Support security and audit requirements aligned with frameworks such as CIS, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP.

•
Develop and maintain security standards, SOPs, hardening guidelines, assessment methodologies, technical documentation and operational runbooks.

•
Continuously identify opportunities to automate preventive and detective security controls and improve overall Cloud Security and DevSecOps maturity.

•
Participate in broader Information Security activities including vulnerability management, security assessments, incident investigations, security reviews, audit/compliance.

Skills
To be successful in this role, you should have:

•
Strong hands-on understanding of at least one major public cloud platform, preferably AWS, with working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP being an advantage.

•
Good understanding of cloud security across IAM, compute, storage, networking, encryption, logging and monitoring.

•
Knowledge of cloud security services such as AWS IAM/IAM Identity Center, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS and EKS, or equivalent services in Azure/GCP.

•
Hands-on understanding of CI/CD and DevSecOps security, including SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets scanning, IaC scanning and container/image security.

•
Experience with CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent platforms.

•
Working knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code security.

•
Good understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, Kubernetes RBAC, container security and cluster hardening.

•
Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash or similar languages.

•
Strong understanding of IAM, least privilege, MFA, privileged access, credential management and access governance.

•
Understanding of CSPM, KSPM, CWPP and CNAPP concepts.

•
Knowledge of cloud/network security concepts including VPC/VNet, Security Groups, firewalls, WAF, TLS/mTLS and private/public connectivity.

•
Experience with security monitoring, alert triage and threat/exposure-management platforms such as CloudSEK or equivalent solutions.

•
Exposure to security tooling such as Snyk or equivalent SAST/SCA, CSPM, container and infrastructure security solutions.

•
Understanding of vulnerability management, risk-based remediation and security incident investigation.

•
Knowledge of security standards and frameworks including CIS Benchmarks, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP.

•
Ability to independently analyse security findings, document security risks and provide clear and practical remediation recommendations to technical stakeholders.

•
3–6 years of relevant experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security or related security engineering roles.

•
Strong hands-on technical experience in cloud security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management and security automation.

The leader will ensure that Zeta’s technology ecosystem is integrated, scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with business objectives. 
The primary charter is to connect and optimize the existing technology ecosystem — integrating SaaS, on-premise, cloud, legacy, and internally developed applications; building bridge systems and software solutions where required; and selectively applying AI and automation to improve workflows, data movement, operational efficiency, and user experience. 
Alongside this, the role provides strategic and operational oversight of IT infrastructure and IT operations, including networks, endpoints, cloud, Microsoft 365, service desk, application support, reliability, security, and technology governance.

Enterprise Applications & Technology Strategy

•
Own the roadmap for the organization's Enterprise Application ecosystem, including SaaS, on-premise, cloud, legacy, and internally developed applications.

•
Oversee business-critical platforms including Project Management, Collaboration, HRMS, Payroll, ATS, LMS, Telephony, and internally developed applications.

•
Evaluate existing technology capabilities and determine whether requirements should be addressed through configuration, integration, automation, AI, or custom software development.

Drive application lifecycle management, modernization, consolidation, and optimization.

Lead technology evaluations, vendor selection, RFI/RFP processes, POCs, negotiations, renewals, and vendor performance management.

Oversee the complete software lifecycle from requirements and architecture through development, integration, testing, deployment, and operations.

•
Identify gaps between existing platforms and oversee the development of bridge applications, middleware, APIs, and integration services to connect disparate systems.

•
Ensure new applications and solutions integrate into the broader enterprise ecosystem rather than creating additional technology silos.

•
Establish standards for software architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, observability, and maintainability.

AI & Intelligent Automation

Identify practical opportunities to apply AI, AI agents, LLMs, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration across the existing application ecosystem.

•
Use AI to enhance application integration, automate data movement and business processes, and create intelligent interfaces between systems.

•
Oversee the development of AI-enabled bridge solutions that can interpret, transform, route, and orchestrate information across multiple applications.

•
Evaluate AI solutions alongside conventional integration and automation approaches, selecting the appropriate technology for each business problem.

•
Establish appropriate governance around AI, data access, security, privacy, and operational reliability.

Provide strategic and operational oversight of the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, endpoints, cloud services, collaboration platforms, Microsoft 365, identity, and core technology platforms.

Ensure infrastructure is scalable, resilient, secure, and capable of supporting the organization's application and digital transformation roadmap.

•
Partner with infrastructure and engineering teams to design and maintain reliable application and infrastructure environments.

Oversee infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and technology resilience.

•
Ensure infrastructure architecture supports the organization's integration, software, data, and AI initiatives.

Ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and supportability across applications, infrastructure, integrations, and critical technology services.

•
Establish appropriate monitoring and observability across applications, APIs, integrations, infrastructure, and AI-enabled workflows.

Drive automation and data-driven operational practices to improve service quality and reduce manual intervention.

Ensure a strong employee technology experience across the organization.

Partner with cybersecurity teams to maintain appropriate controls across applications, infrastructure, integrations, cloud environments, and endpoints.

Ensure compliance with frameworks including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and applicable data protection regulations.

Establish technology governance covering architecture, applications, integrations, AI, infrastructure, vendors, and operational risk.

Own and optimize the technology budget across applications, software development, infrastructure, and operations.

Data, Analytics & Automation

Define and oversee enterprise data architecture and data engineering pipelines across business systems.

Build analytics and dashboards providing visibility into application usage, operational performance, adoption, service levels, integration health, and technology costs.

•
Drive automation across application, infrastructure, and service management functions.

•
Leverage data and AI to identify operational inefficiencies and continuously improve technology services.

Build, lead, mentor, and scale high-performing teams across Enterprise Applications, Software Engineering, Integration, Infrastructure, IT Operations, and Service Management.

Establish clear ownership, accountability, delivery standards, and performance metrics across technology teams.

Partner closely with business, security, finance, HR, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into integrated technology solutions.

Lead cross-functional transformation programs from strategy through execution, ensuring delivery within scope, timeline, and budget.

About the Role
The Manager – Accounts will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end finance operations including Accounts Payable, General Ledger, month-end close, statutory and group audits, treasury operations, and providing finance support for corporate restructuring initiatives across Zeta Group entities.
The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, leadership capability, and the ability to operate in a fast-growing, multi-entity environment.
An ambitious individual who can deal with ambiguity and is interested in working for a growth-phase company would be an ideal fit for the role.

Responsibilities
1. Financial Accounting & Month-End Close

• Own and manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

• Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, and reconciliations.

• Ensure compliance with Ind AS / IFRS and Group accounting policies.

• Monitor balance sheet integrity and drive resolution of open items.

2. Accounts Payable & Payments

• Oversee Accounts Payable operations, including vendor accounting, invoice processing, and aging management.

• Ensure timely processing of vendor payments in line with agreed credit terms and internal controls.

• Review and approve bank payments through ERP and banking platforms.

• Drive process improvements and automation in AP workflows.

3. General Ledger & Controls

• Lead the General Ledger function across multiple entities.

• Ensure robust internal controls, SOPs, and documentation.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve accounting issues and improve data quality.

4. Audits & Compliance

• Act as the primary point of contact for statutory, internal, and group audits.

• Coordinate audit planning, data readiness, and closure of audit queries.

• Ensure timely completion of audits with minimal adjustments and no major qualifications.

• Support compliance with statutory requirements, including filings and regulatory submissions.

5. Treasury & Banking

• Oversee treasury operations, including cash flow monitoring, fund utilization, and banking relationships.

• Manage bank accounts, signatories, and payment authorization controls.

• Support cash forecasting and liquidity planning in coordination with leadership.

6. Restructuring & Special Projects

• Provide accounting and finance support for group restructuring, de-mergers, mergers, and internal reorganizations.

• Assist in implementation of accounting treatments, disclosures, and audit coordination related to restructuring.

• Support system migrations, process transitions, and finance transformation initiatives.

7. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop the finance operations team.

• Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to timelines and quality standards.

• Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Tax, FP&A, and Business teams.

Skills
• Strong knowledge of Ind AS / IFRS.

• Expertise in month-end close, AP, GL, audits, and treasury

• Experience in multi-entity / group structures

• Strong analytical, review, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

About the Product
Zeta is building a new consumer banking product for the US market. The focus is learning fast which features drive adoption, engagement and retention — and building them well.
 
About the Role
You'll help grow the product through a steady cadence of experiments and feature launches. Each PM owns a business-outcome metric for one area of the product, and the roadmap that moves it. Example areas: onboarding and activation, engagement and retention, revenue, and trust and risk.
We need a hustler. The work will feel like a very early-stage startup: ambiguous problems, incomplete information, shifting priorities and no playbook. You'll bring structure to the chaos: find the answers, make the calls and get things shipped.
We expect PMs to use AI tools across the lifecycle — research, specs, prototyping, analysis — to keep iteration cycles short. PMs here go deep on how things are built, so hands-on software development experience is mandatory.

Responsibilities
1. Own a metric

• Own a business-outcome metric for your area, plus the guardrail metrics it must not trade away.

• Keep a ranked backlog of experiments and features, prioritised by expected impact (RICE, ICE or similar).

2. Run experiments

• Write each bet as a hypothesis with a primary metric, guardrails and a decision rule, all set before launch.

• Match the method to the traffic: A/B tests and holdouts at scale; fake doors, usability tests and cohort analysis at low volume.

• Size tests properly, report null and negative results as plainly as wins, and make the ship, iterate or kill call.

• Keep a running log of what was tested, what was learned and what changed.

3. Build features

• Take features from problem definition through spec, build, QA, launch and adoption.

• Write specs engineers can build from: flows, edge cases, failure states, event instrumentation and acceptance criteria.

• Work through technical design with engineering — APIs, data models, ledger and payment flows, third-party integrations — and make trade-off calls quickly.

4. Measure

• Define output metrics (acquisition, activation, revenue, engagement) and the input metrics that drive them (funnel conversion, feature usage).

• Own event instrumentation and data quality for your area.

• Do your own analysis in SQL, product analytics tools (such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or MoEngage) and BI tools (such as Metabase or Superset).

5. Research users

• Run continuous discovery with US customers through remote interviews, usability tests and surveys.

• Turn what you hear and what the data shows into clear problem statements that feed the backlog.

6. Shape the UX

• Partner with designers on simple flows that earn users' trust.

• Own product copy for your area.

7. Launch and support

• Ship behind feature flags and in stages, with monitoring and a rollback plan.

• Work with compliance, risk, banking partners, operations and support so every launch meets regulatory requirements and can be supported from day one.

Skills
• Statistics and experiment design: hypothesis testing, significance, power and sample sizing, and common traps such as peeking and novelty effects.

• Strong SQL, and fluency with product analytics and BI tools.

• Ability to work through messy data sets and turn them into decisions.

• Engineering fundamentals you still use: reading code, system design, APIs and data models.

• A keen eye for design, and strong UX writing.

• Clear written and verbal communication — specs and experiment readouts people can act on.

• Meticulous program management across parallel workstreams.

• Hands-on experience with user research.

Experience and Qualifications
• 6+ years of total experience, including: 3–4 years in product management, with features shipped and measured in production. At least 3 years of hands-on software development, writing and shipping production code as an engineer. This is mandatory.

• A track record of experiments that changed a product decision.

• Preferred: consumer fintech, payments or banking experience, ideally in the US.

• Preferred: B2C products with a growth or experimentation focus.

Equal Opportunity
 
Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success

Guide developers in fixing security issues. 
Regular code reviews

The applications are developed by the developers and product managers, and you will make sure the applications are secured and hardened.

Liasoning with all external and internal stakeholders for the team.

About the Role: The Senior Facility Executive will be responsible for managing day-to-day facility operations, housekeeping, cafeteria and pantry services, vendor management, general administration, inventory control, and workplace upkeep. The role requires strong operational ownership, effective team coordination, proactive monitoring of service standards, timely closure of complaints, and ensuring a clean, safe, hygienic, and well-maintained workplace

Responsibilities
1. Facility Operations & Administration

· Manage day-to-day facility operations and general administrative activities.

· Monitor staff attendance and allocate daily tasks to shift supervisors.

· Coordinate with shift executives to prepare duty rosters and share them with the reporting manager.

· Conduct regular inspections of the front office, lobby, work areas, and restrooms to maintain high standards of housekeeping and upkeep.

· Ensure newspapers and magazines are available and appropriately placed in the front office.

· Plan and monitor weekend activities and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Prepare daily snag reports, track pending issues, and coordinate with internal teams for closure.

· Conduct regular facility inspections and verify that completed work meets the required standards.

· Ensure the workplace remains clean, organized, safe, and operationally ready.

2. Housekeeping, Pantry & Cafeteria Management

· Oversee housekeeping, cleaning, pest control, pantry, and cafeteria operations to ensure hygiene, cleanliness, and service quality.

· Monitor housekeeping staff deployment, attendance, grooming, and work quality.

· Ensure regular cleaning and upkeep of men's and women's restrooms, common areas, and cafeteria spaces.

· Ensure bedspreads are sent for washing monthly and maintain appropriate records.

· Monitor cafeteria operations, food quality, freshness, presentation, and timely service during designated meal periods.

· Coordinate with cafeteria vendors to ensure adequate food availability, quality, hygiene, and adherence to agreed service standards.

· Conduct regular and surprise inspections of the cafeteria, dining areas, serving counters, and other food service areas.

· Collect employee feedback, address cafeteria-related complaints, and coordinate corrective actions with vendors.

· Monitor food consumption, wastage, and service efficiency and identify opportunities for improvement.

· Check pantry and housekeeping consumable stock levels, verify reorder requirements, and inform the reporting manager to initiate replenishment.

· Prepare and submit pantry and housekeeping consumption reports.

· Check vending machines and water coolers daily and coordinate with internal technicians to resolve faults.

· Ensure cafeteria equipment, refrigerators, water dispensers, and other appliances are maintained in good working condition.

3. Complaint, Snag & Escalation Management

· Review pending complaints and action items, prioritize issues, and drive timely closure.

· Coordinate with internal support teams and external vendors to resolve facility-related issues.

· Maintain complaint trackers and daily snag reports, ensuring clear ownership and closure timelines.

· Proactively identify operational challenges and keep managers informed of issues requiring escalation.

· Track recurring complaints and coordinate corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

· Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure service requests are resolved within agreed timelines.

4. Vendor & Service Management

· Coordinate with vendors providing housekeeping, cafeteria, pantry, pest control, and other facility-related services.

· Monitor vendor attendance, manpower deployment, performance, and service delivery against agreed standards.

· Verify the quality and completion of vendor work before confirming closure.

· Conduct periodic and surprise inspections to ensure compliance with service standards.

· Coordinate with internal technicians and relevant teams to resolve equipment faults and maintenance issues.

· Review cafeteria and other facility vendor invoices against agreed commercial terms, services delivered, and supporting documents.

· Maintain vendor performance records and escalate recurring service deficiencies.

5. Inventory, Procurement & Cost Control

· Monitor housekeeping, pantry, and cafeteria consumables and maintain adequate stock levels.

· Track consumption, verify reorder levels, and coordinate procurement approvals with the reporting manager.

· Maintain accurate stock registers, consumption reports, and supporting documentation.

· Monitor food consumption and wastage and support cost-control initiatives.

· Ensure materials and consumables are used efficiently and replenished on time.

· Organize, maintain, and coordinate administrative functions and departmental records.

· Handle filing, documentation, and maintenance of facility-related reports.

· Coordinate outdoor activities, liaison work, and follow-ups with external agencies and business stakeholders.

· Review and process vendor bills, ensuring supporting documents and service completion details are verified.

· Take ownership of pending follow-ups and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.

· Prepare operational updates and reports for senior management and the reporting manager.

· Maintain duty rosters, attendance records, inspection checklists, complaint trackers, and vendor documentation.

7. Workplace Readiness & Flexibility

· Support planned facility activities, audits, inspections, and special events as assigned.

· Take initiative in identifying improvement opportunities and resolving operational challenges.

The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

• Communication is key, and we don't let walls hinder it. We work directly with other teams and strive for clear communication.

fields.location: Pan India (Delhi, Mumbai, Vadodara, Sivasagar, Chennai)
fields.skills_required: Basic Technical Knowledge, Safety Awareness, Aptitude For Engineering Trades, Basic Computer Literacy
fields.description:
Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) is India’s flagship energy major and a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise. With a legacy spanning over six decades, ONGC is the country’s largest producer of crude oil and natural gas, operating across the upstream value chain – from exploration and drilling to production and processing. The corporation’s vision is to fuel the nation’s growth while championing sustainable practices, cutting‑edge technology, and a robust safety culture. As part of its Skill Building Initiative, ONGC runs a nationwide apprenticeship programme across 24 work centres, offering fresh talent a hands‑on platform to learn industry‑relevant skills under seasoned professionals.

The Apprentice role is designed for recent graduates, diploma holders, and ITI pass-outs who wish to start their career in the oil and gas sector. Apprentices will be posted at one of the designated locations – Delhi, Mumbai, Vadodara, Sivasagar or Chennai – based on merit and availability. Under the mentorship of senior engineers and technicians, apprentices will rotate through core operational units, gaining exposure to drilling operations, pipeline maintenance, instrumentation, safety protocols, and basic project management. The programme spans 12 months, during which the apprentice receives a monthly stipend, on‑the‑job training, and a certificate of completion that is recognized nationwide.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Assisting senior technicians in routine maintenance and inspection of equipment.
2. Supporting drilling and production teams with data collection and basic analysis.
3. Learning and adhering to safety standards, emergency response procedures, and environmental guidelines.
4. Participating in daily briefings, reporting observations, and suggesting process improvements.
5. Conducting basic troubleshooting of mechanical and electrical systems under supervision.
6. Maintaining accurate logs of work performed, materials used, and time spent.
7. Helping in the preparation of work permits and compliance documentation.
8. Engaging in on‑site training sessions, workshops, and safety drills.
9. Collaborating with cross‑functional teams to understand the end‑to‑end workflow of oil and gas operations.
10. Completing periodic assessments and presenting learning outcomes to mentors.

The technical stack is practical rather than software‑centric, focusing on tools such as hand‑held diagnostic devices, basic PLC interfaces, MS Office for reporting, and industry‑standard safety equipment. Growth path for apprentices is clearly defined – high performers may be offered a Technician position or be considered for entry‑level engineering roles after successfully clearing the internal assessment and meeting eligibility criteria. The apprenticeship experience also enhances employability across the broader energy sector, given ONGC’s reputation for rigorous training and adherence to global standards.

Why join ONGC as an apprentice? You will be part of a prestigious organization that values skill development, offers exposure to large‑scale projects, and provides a structured learning environment. The programme not only equips you with technical know‑how but also instills a safety‑first mindset, teamwork, and problem‑solving abilities that are highly prized in the industry. Moreover, the stipend, certification, and potential for future employment make this an attractive launchpad for a long‑term career in energy.
fields.eligibility: Indian citizens only. Minimum educational qualification: 10+2 (Science/Commerce) or Diploma in Engineering/Technology from a recognized board/institution. Minimum aggregate of 55% in qualifying exam. No active backlogs. Candidates from the 2025, 2026 or 2027 graduating batches are eligible. Freshers can apply; prior work experience is not required. Must be physically fit as per ONGC medical standards and willing to relocate to any of the listed locations.

About the Team
 
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. After all, when 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this – with zero downtime! 😎 Sounds impossible? Well, that’s the kind of Engineering muscle that has helped Meesho become the e-commerce giant it is today. We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. As a Security Engineer, you will be part of self-starters who thrive on teamwork and constructive feedback. We know how to party as hard as we work! If we aren’t building unparalleled tech solutions, you can find us debating the plot points of our favorite books and games – or even gossiping over chai. So, if a day filled with building impactful solutions with a fun team sounds appealing to you, join us.
 
About the Role
 
As a Security Engineer 4, your role is integral in ensuring the security of our products throughout their development lifecycle. You will be involved from the very beginning, participating in threat modeling and design reviews to identify potential risks early. You'll also integrate and manage SAST tools within our CI/CD pipeline, ensuring continuous security testing as code evolves. Additionally, you'll lead and conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing (VAPT) to proactively uncover and address security vulnerabilities before they reach production.

What you will do
• Lead and manage all aspects of the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

• Implement and manage security tools within the CI/CD pipeline (DevSecOps).

• Conduct and oversee VAPT for web applications, APIs, iOS, and Android apps.

• Perform threat modeling, design, and architecture reviews to identify potential risks.

• Execute manual source code reviews and enhance security in production environments.

• Manage and optimize a self-managed bug bounty program.

• Provide security architectural guidance to Engineering and IT teams.

• Manage issues identified from penetration tests and bug bounty programs.

• Lead security training and awareness campaigns across the organization.

• Manage Web Application Firewalls (WAF) to ensure robust protection.

• Engage in the Security Champions program to integrate security practices within teams.

• Assist in creating and maintaining Security Risk Models for both new and existing systems.

What you will need
• 7+ years of experience in product security, with a focus on application security and Dev SecOps.

• Proven experience in leading architectural changes or cross-team efforts to mitigate security vulnerabilities.

• Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, React, Node.js, and Python.

• Hands-on experience with manual source code reviews and securing production code.

• Expertise in deploying and managing security tools in CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience with Git, Jenkins, Artifactory, or other similar technologies.

• Strong background in securing the software development lifecycle, including eliminating classes of vulnerabilities.

• Proficiency with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, including their security tools.

• Experience with Docker and containerization technologies is highly desirable.

• Additional experience in infrastructure security, particularly in GCP, Docker, and containerization, is a bonus.

Bonus Points
• Relevant certifications such as GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT), OffSec’s Advanced Web Attacks and Exploitation (WEB-300), etc.

• Strong understanding of SSO protocols, including OAuth and SAML.

• Experience speaking at meetups or conferences.

• Experience participating in bug bounty programs.

About us 
Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
Culture and Total Rewards
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

HP’s Indian operations span research, development, manufacturing, and supply chain, providing fresh graduates with exposure to cutting‑edge technologies and large‑scale business processes. Employees benefit from structured learning programs, mentorship, and a collaborative environment that encourages continuous improvement.

The Business Analyst – Inventory Reconciliation role sits within HP’s Supply Chain & Operations function. As a fresher, you will be responsible for managing end‑to‑end supply chain processes for a country or regional business unit, focusing on inventory analysis, order fulfillment, and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) variance resolution. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams—IT, finance, partner operations, and regional planners—to gather data, build dashboards, and drive process improvements that enhance operational efficiency.

8. Communicate process guidelines and requirements to planning teams and conduct training for new hires.
9. Understand HP’s E2E EDI architecture, collaborate with IT and partner systems to fix recurring variance issues.
10. Drive cross‑functional programs to permanently resolve EDI variances and improve supply chain reliability.

Tech Stack & Tools: SAP S/4HANA, Excel/Power BI, SQL for data extraction, basic knowledge of EDI standards (EDIFACT, ANSI X12), and familiarity with project management tools.

Growth Path: Starting as a Business Analyst, you can progress to Senior Analyst, Supply Chain Planning Manager, or specialize in EDI Architecture, Data Analytics, or Operations Excellence. HP offers rotational programs and certifications (e.g., PMP, CPIM) to accelerate career growth.

Why Join HP? You will work in a globally recognised brand that invests heavily in employee development, offers exposure to large‑scale supply chain operations, and provides a supportive environment for fresh talent to make a tangible impact on business outcomes.

fields.description:
Konrad is a fast‑growing digital consultancy that partners with global brands to solve complex business challenges through technology, design and strategy. With a strong focus on innovation, the company builds end‑to‑end digital products ranging from mobile apps to enterprise platforms. Operating from multiple hubs worldwide, Konrad’s Gurgaon office serves as a key delivery centre for clients across finance, retail, healthcare and logistics. The firm promotes a collaborative culture where engineers, designers and strategists work side‑by‑side, encouraging continuous learning, knowledge sharing and rapid skill development.

As a QA Engineer at Konrad, you will be the guardian of software quality across a diverse portfolio of projects. You will work closely with project managers, developers and senior quality engineers to understand functional requirements, translate them into detailed test cases and execute comprehensive testing cycles. Your day‑to‑day activities will involve manual testing, user acceptance testing (UAT) on multiple devices, operating systems and browsers, and meticulous defect documentation using JIRA. You will also verify bug fixes, ensure regression stability and contribute to the creation of reusable test assets. The role offers one day per week of work‑from‑home flexibility while the majority of the work remains office‑based, fostering strong team interaction.

**Key Responsibilities**
1. Conduct regular quality checks for multiple software projects.
2. Execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and major browsers.
3. Design, develop and maintain detailed test case scenarios based on functional specifications.
4. Log, track and prioritize defects in JIRA with clear reproduction steps and screenshots.
5. Communicate testing outcomes and raise issues with developers and project stakeholders.
6. Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing to ensure no side‑effects.
7. Review supported devices and browsers to guarantee consistent user experience.
8. Collaborate with Project Managers and quality engineering specialists to align testing scope with business goals.
9. Assist development teams with additional project‑related tasks as needed.
10. Contribute ideas for process improvement, test automation possibilities and quality metrics.

**Tech Stack & Tools**: Microsoft Word, Excel, JIRA, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, various browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). While the role is primarily manual, exposure to basic scripting or automation concepts is advantageous.

**Growth Path**: Starting as a QA Engineer, high performers can progress to Senior QA Engineer, QA Lead, or Quality Engineering Manager within 2‑4 years. Konrad encourages certifications such as ISTQB and offers internal training programs to accelerate career growth.

**Why Join Konrad?** The company offers a vibrant, learning‑centric environment, competitive compensation, social events, subsidised lunch and a culture that values work‑life balance. The one‑day‑per‑week remote option provides flexibility without compromising team cohesion. If you are detail‑oriented, love collaborating across functions and want to build a solid foundation in software quality, Konrad is an ideal place to launch or accelerate your QA career.

fields.description:
Scaler, a leading Indian ed‑tech platform that up‑skills software engineers, has partnered with Wispr Flow, a cutting‑edge voice‑to‑text AI, to launch a nation‑wide hackathon called “India Runs on Voice”. The event is designed to tap into India’s linguistic diversity and create voice‑first tools that can be used by billions of people across the country. Scaler’s mission is to democratise high‑quality tech education, while Wispr’s vision is to make voice the primary interaction mode for every digital product. Together they provide participants with mentorship, master‑classes, and access to Wispr Flow’s API, enabling rapid prototyping of voice‑driven solutions.

The hackathon runs in three rounds from 5 Nov 2026 to 13 Dec 2026. Round 1 is an online warm‑up where participants submit ideas, prompts and impact statements using only their voice. Round 2 offers a unified problem statement; teams of up to three build a functional prototype, guided by a live master‑class from Wispr engineers. The final round is an on‑campus showcase where shortlisted teams demo their solutions before Wispr leadership, AI founders and investors. The prize pool of ₹30 L is split among the top 15 teams, with the first‑place team receiving ₹7 L and a year’s subscription to Flow Pro for each member.

Key responsibilities for participants include: 
1. Identify a real‑world problem within one of the five theme tracks (civic services, healthcare, education, small business, everyday access). 
2. Conduct rapid user research in regional languages to validate the problem. 
3. Design voice‑first user flows that work hands‑free on low‑spec devices. 
4. Implement the solution using Wispr Flow’s SDK, integrating speech‑to‑text, intent detection and language translation where needed. 
5. Optimize the prototype for latency, accuracy and offline capability. 
6. Prepare a compelling pitch deck and demo script entirely in voice. 
7. Collaborate with teammates via voice‑only communication tools. 
8. Iterate based on mentor feedback during the master‑class. 
9. Present a live demo at the campus finale, answering technical and business questions. 
10. Document the code and share open‑source contributions for community impact. 

The tech stack revolves around Wispr Flow (speech‑to‑text, natural language understanding), any front‑end framework (React, Flutter, Android), backend services (Node.js, Python Flask), and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP). Participants gain hands‑on experience with voice AI, multilingual NLP, and rapid prototyping—skills highly sought after by product companies building inclusive tech.

Growth path: successful participants can be invited for internships or full‑time roles at Wispr, Scaler’s product teams, or partner startups looking for voice‑first innovators. The exposure to investors and AI leaders also opens doors to startup funding or mentorship.

Why join? This is a unique chance to build for a billion users, work in any Indian language, and receive mentorship from industry experts—all without any entry fee. Winners walk away with cash prizes, a year of premium Flow Pro, an international trip to Singapore, and direct interview opportunities with Wispr. Even non‑winners gain a portfolio‑ready voice‑AI project and a network of like‑minded builders across India.

Minimum 60% academic record preferred but not mandatory. No backlog restrictions; participants must be legally eligible to work in India.

8-12 years of work experience with substantial experience in managing a geographically

You will build the large-scale data pipelines and agentic AI features that power our platform on AWS. • Write and tune PySpark jobs on EMR (EMR on EKS) and Delta Lake to prepare and transform data at scale

• Build and maintain Python services and shared libraries, and Kafka producers/consumers for moving data between services
• Serve agents behind APIs and monitor them with LLM/agent observability (quality, cost, latency, failures)
• Write design docs and collaborate with engineers and data scientists on architecture decisions
• Use AI coding agents in your own day-to-day workflow while owning correctness and quality

• Python 3 — solid experience writing production code, with strong fundamentals and readable, tested code, using a web framework such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
• PySpark & SQL — hands-on experience writing and tuning Spark jobs on EMR (we run EMR on EKS), reading/writing Delta Lake tables, and strong SQL for large-scale data
• Agentic AI — hands-on experience building LLM or agent-based features: tool/function calling, multi-step agent workflows, RAG, and grounding output in real data.
• Experience writing production Python 3, including designing and optimizing large-scale data processing solutions
• Experience building services or APIs with a Python web framework such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
• Hands-on experience with Spark / PySpark, ideally on EMR (EMR on EKS a plus)

• Hands-on experience building LLM or agent-based features (tool calling, function calling, or multi-step agent workflows)

• Experience with RAG: embeddings, vector search, and grounding model output in real data

• Experience with at least one database (MongoDB/DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, or similar)
• Experience with AWS services such as S3 and EMR

Preferred Qualifications

fields.description:
Infosys BPM (Business Process Management) is a global leader in next‑generation digital and consulting services, part of the Infosys Group. With a presence in more than 30 countries, Infosys BPM helps clients transform their business processes through automation, analytics and deep domain expertise. The company is known for its strong learning culture, robust training programs and clear career progression pathways, making it an attractive destination for fresh graduates looking to start a professional journey in the BPO sector.

The role advertised is for a Process Executive – Data, targeted at commerce graduates (B.Com, BBA, BBM) from the 2025‑2026 batches. As a Process Executive, you will work from the Bengaluru office, primarily handling data‑related tasks that combine voice interaction and data entry. The position operates on a night‑shift or flexible schedule, reflecting the 24×7 service model of Infosys BPM. Candidates will be expected to manage outbound calls, follow scripted dialogues, conduct website research, and accurately input information into the company’s systems. The role offers a structured training period, exposure to real‑time client interactions, and a clear path to senior positions such as Senior Executive, Team Lead, and Operations Manager.

Key responsibilities include:
1. Conducting outbound calls to customers following predefined scripts.
2. Performing high‑volume data entry with a focus on accuracy and speed.
3. Researching information on websites and interpreting content for entry.
4. Managing multi‑tasking of voice calls and data entry simultaneously.
5. Maintaining professional and courteous communication with customers at all times.
6. Adhering to night‑shift schedules and rotational shift patterns.
7. Using basic computer applications such as MS Office, CRM tools, and data‑entry software.
8. Analyzing call outcomes and providing feedback for process improvement.
9. Ensuring compliance with data‑privacy and security guidelines.
10. Collaborating with team members and supervisors to meet daily targets.

The technical stack for this role is straightforward: proficiency in Windows OS, MS Office (Excel, Word), internet browsers for research, and familiarity with CRM or data‑entry platforms used by Infosys BPM. No advanced programming knowledge is required, but a keen eye for detail and the ability to quickly learn new software are essential.

Growth at Infosys BPM is merit‑based. Freshers start as Process Executives and can progress to Senior Executive within 12‑18 months based on performance, followed by Team Lead, Assistant Manager, and higher managerial roles. The company invests heavily in continuous learning through internal academies, certifications, and cross‑functional exposure, enabling employees to acquire new skills and take on more complex responsibilities.

Why join Infosys BPM? The brand offers a stable work environment, competitive compensation, and a robust onboarding program that equips freshers with industry‑relevant skills. Employees benefit from a collaborative culture, regular performance feedback, and opportunities to work on global client projects, which enhances both professional growth and employability in the broader BPO and IT services market.
